npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_1: [EN] Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_10: [EN] Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_11: [EN] Maintainin' this whole operation, the dwarven involvement 'course. Don't know about them gnomes but if I ain't gettin' those dwarves in line, there'll be chaos down here. I also oversee the {defences} and {counterattacks}.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_7:
[EN] The attacks of the enemy forces are fierce but we hold our ground. ...  \z
	I'd love to face one of their generals in combat but as their masters they cowardly hide far behind enemy lines and I have other duties to fulfil. ...  \z
	I envy you for the chance to thrust into the heart of the enemy, locking weapons with their jaws... or whatever... and see the fear in their eyes when they recognise they were bested.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_8:
[EN] I welcome a fine battle as any dwarf worth his beard should do. As long as it's a battle against something I can hit with my trusty axe. ... \z
	But here the true {enemy} eludes us. We fight wave after wave of their lackeys and if the gnomes are right the true enemy is up to something far more sinister.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_9:
[EN] I have no idea what kind of creeps are behind all this. Even the gnomes don't and they have handled that stuff way more often. ... \z
	But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
npc.kroox.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to Kroox Quality Armor, |PLAYERNAME|! Wanna take a look, ask me for a trade.
npc.kroox.multi_1: [EN] Oh, so its you, he wrote me about? Sadly I have no dwarven armor in stock. But I give you the permission to retrive one from the mines. ...
npc.kroox.multi_2: [EN] The problem is, some giant spiders made the tunnels where the storage is their new home. Good luck.
npc.kroox.say_1: [EN] Hm, well I guess its ok to tell you ... <tells you about Lokurs measurements>
npc.kulag_the_guard.say_1: [EN] You adventurers become more and more of a pest.
npc.kulag_the_guard.say_2: [EN] They should throw you all into jail instead of giving you all those quests and rewards an honest watchman can only dream about.
npc.kulag_the_guard.stdmod_1: [EN] It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.lailene.greet_msg_1: [EN] What do you want in my magical robe store? I doubt I have anything that's of interest to you.
npc.lailene.stdmod_1: [EN] ... what?! Uh - no, no. Of course I wouldn't have anything to do with... them.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.greet_msg_1: [EN] Since you are obviously not one of my relatives who pays me a long overdue visit, we should get {work} right away. We'll see if you can prove your {worth} to our alliance.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_1: [EN] I can't explain that stuff, even the gnomes don't know what grows in those caves. All we know is that this stuff brought about all the diremaws we are now facing. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_10: [EN] We built an iron fence around it and added a mechanism to quickly get barrel if need be. Then an... accident happened to our guard down there and ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_11: [EN] Well, to make a long story short, the barrels are unguarded right now and the diremaws are now too numerous and we are in desperate need of volunteers. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_12: [EN] We need someone to take those barrels to the source of the ever growing sponge and burn it down. All of it. There should be at least five locations. Are you up for that?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_13: [EN] The gnomes say that these creatures seem to thrive on mushroom sponges. But not only that, apparently they also lay eggs in their own cadavers to breed even faster. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_14: [EN] Yes, disgusting. I guess it provides everything their offspring needs... well, we probably shouldn't go into that much further. Instead we should focus on preventing that from happening. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_15: [EN] If I understood that correctly, the gnomes 'grew' a device to completely neutralise diremaw corpses. Acting as a very effective counter measure. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_16: [EN] A lot of corpses are lying around wherever these creatures are being hunted. Now all we need are, you guessed it, volunteers to clean up as many of those remains as possible ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_18: [EN] The gnomes say that these creatures seem to thrive on mushroom sponges. But not only that, apparently they also lay eggs in their own cadavers to breed even faster. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_19: [EN] Yes, disgusting. I guess it provides everything their offspring needs... well, we probably shouldn't go into that much further. Instead we should focus on preventing that from happening. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_2: [EN] This vermin is somehow attracted to this sponge, my guess is they use it as a nourishment, too. We need to get rid of the stuff regularly to reduce their numbers to a manageable level. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_20: [EN] If I understood that correctly, the gnomes 'grew' a device to completely neutralise diremaw corpses. Acting as a very effective counter measure. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_21: [EN] A lot of corpses are lying around wherever these creatures are being hunted. Now all we need are, you guessed it, volunteers to clean up as many of those remains as possible ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_3: [EN] We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_4: [EN] We built an iron fence around it and added a mechanism to quickly get barrel if need be. Then an... accident happened to our guard down there and ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_5: [EN] Well, to make a long story short, the barrels are unguarded right now and the diremaws are now too numerous and we are in desperate need of volunteers. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_6: [EN] We need someone to take those barrels to the source of the ever growing sponge and burn it down. All of it. There should be at least five locations. Are you up for that?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_7: [EN] I can't explain that stuff, even the gnomes don't know what grows in those caves. All we know is that this stuff brought about all the diremaws we are now facing. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_8: [EN] This vermin is somehow attracted to this sponge, my guess is they use it as a nourishment, too. We need to get rid of the stuff regularly to reduce their numbers to a manageable level. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_9: [EN] We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_1: [EN] You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_11: [EN] You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_13: [EN] You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_15: [EN] You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_16: [EN] So you want to know what we all think about your deeds? What leader's opinion are you interested in, the {gnomes} (Gnomus), the {dwarves} (Klom Stonecutter) or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_17: [EN] You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_18: [EN] The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_19: [EN] The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_2: [EN] The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_20: [EN] The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_3: [EN] The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_4: [EN] The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_5: [EN] I don't need your help for now. Come back later.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_6: [EN] You did a great job out there, the stuff will continue to grow, however. Return to me later for more work.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_7: [EN] Noted. Now, get down there and rain some fire on them.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_8: [EN] If you bring me any suspicious devices on creatures you slay down here, I'll make it worth your while by telling the others of your generosity. How many do you want to offer?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_1: [EN] Here's the situation: a tide of hazardous bugs, the gnomes named them {diremaws}, threatens our base. Then there is some kind of {growth} which seems connected to them somehow. We need to get rid of both.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_2: [EN] Bashsmite. That's all you need to know.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_3:
[EN] You're already known amongst the gnomes, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. I will make sure that the alliance learns of your deeds but you'll still need to help the dwarves and gnomes of this outpost to show your worth. ... \z
	We also found suspicious devices carried by all kinds of creatures down here. Down here, they are of extreme worth to us since they could contain the key to what's happening all around us. ...  \z
	If you can aquire any, return them to me and I make sure to tell the others of your generosity. Return to me afterwards to check on your current {status}.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_4:
[EN] Leading the charge! It's a war down here. I maintain the outer defences and supplies which are organised back in Kazordoon and also by the gnomes. ... \z
	I have sealed some of the areas far too dangerous for anyone to enter. If you can prove you're capable, you'll get an oportunity to help destroying the weird machines, pumping lava into the caves leading to the most dangerous enemies. \z
	But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
npc.lazaran.greet_msg_1: [EN] Me greet. You no enemy of tribe.
npc.lazaran.multi_1: [EN] You well did! Great hunt is under best signs now. We prepare weapons and paint faces and then go! ...
npc.lazaran.multi_2: [EN] No no, you no need to help us. But can prepare afterparty! Little men sent us stuff some time ago. Was strange water in there. Brown and stinky! But when we tried all tribe became veeeeeeery happy. ...
npc.lazaran.multi_3: [EN] Now brown water is gone and we sad! Can you bring POT of brown water for party after great hunt? Just bring to me and me trade for shiny treasure.
npc.lazaran.multi_4: [EN] You brought back skull of first leader. Hero of tribe! But we more missions to do. ...
npc.lazaran.multi_5: [EN] Me and Ulala talk about land outside. We wanting to see more of land! Land over big water! But us no can leave tribe. No can cross water. Only way is skull of first leader. ...
npc.lazaran.multi_6: [EN] What holy skull sees, tribe sees. That we believe. Can you bring holy skull over big water and show places?
npc.lazaran.multi_7: [EN] Big problem we have! Skull of first leader gone. He ancestor of whole tribe but died long ago in war. We have keep his skull on our sacred place. ...
npc.lazaran.multi_8: [EN] Then one night, green men came with wolves... and one of wolves took skull and ran off chewing on it! We need back - many wisdom and power is in skull. Maybe they took to north fortress. But can be hard getting in. You try get our holy skull back?
npc.lazaran.say_1: [EN] Me people wanting {peace}. No war with others. No war with {little men}. We few. We weak. Need {help}. We not wanting make {war}. No hurt.
npc.lazaran.say_11: [EN] Here take holy skull. You bring where you think is good. See as much as possible! See where other people live!
npc.lazaran.say_12: [EN] We make big ritual soon and learn much about world outside. Me thank you many times for teaching us world. Very wise and adventurous you are!
npc.lazaran.say_13: [EN] The skull have not seen all yet!
npc.lazaran.say_14: [EN] We need to calm and make happy gods. Best go to Ulala. She is priest of us and can tell what needs doing.
npc.lazaran.say_15: [EN] We make big ritual soon and learn much about world outside. Me thank you many times for teaching us world. Very wise and adventurous you are!
npc.lazaran.say_16: [EN] You do not have the brown strange water!
npc.lazaran.say_17: [EN] Me have many small task, but also big {mission}. You say what want.
npc.lazaran.say_18: [EN] Many mighty monster rule land. We fight. We lose. We flee to mountain to hide.
npc.lazaran.say_19: [EN] We come and see little men. They like us, only very little. They having good weapon and armor, like the greens.
npc.lazaran.say_2: [EN] Oh! You found holy skull? In bone pile you found?! Thank Pandor you brought! Me can have it back?
npc.lazaran.say_3: [EN] You say you was to where sun is hot and burning? And where trees grow as high as mountain? And where Fasuon cries white tears? Me can't wait to see!! Can have holy skull back?
npc.lazaran.say_4: [EN] We been weak for too long! We prepare for great hunt. But still need many doings! You can help us?
npc.lazaran.say_5: [EN] You bring us big pot of strange water from little men?
npc.lazaran.say_6: [EN] Me people wanting peace. No war with others. No war with little men.
npc.lazaran.say_7: [EN] You mean you want help us?
npc.lazaran.say_8: [EN] You hero of our tribe if bring back holy skull!
npc.lazaran.say_9: [EN] Me thank you much! All wisdom safe again now.
npc.lea.stdmod_1: [EN] I am the archsorcerer of Carlin. I keep the secrets of our order.
npc.lea.stdmod_3: [EN] Sorry, I only sell spells to sorcerers.
npc.lea.stdmod_4: [EN] Time is a force we sorcerers will master one day.
npc.lea.stdmod_5: [EN] Any sorcerer dedicates his whole life to the study of the arcane arts.
npc.lea.stdmod_6: [EN] We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lea.stdmod_7: [EN] We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lector.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, take a good look at my meat.
npc.lector.stdmod_1: [EN] I can offer you ham or meat. If you'd like to check the quality of my wares, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.greet_msg_1: [EN] Nice to see you, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my exclusive offers.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_1: [EN] Ask me if you need help!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_10: [EN] There are many merchants in this village. Just ask them for a {trade} to see their offers. But I can promise you - my offers are the best around!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_11: [EN] I'm fine. I'm delighted to welcome you as my customer.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_12: [EN] What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_13: [EN] How can I help you? Would you like to {trade} with me? I can also give you general {hints}. Or just ask me anything you'd like to know.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_14: [EN] You should really take some time and travel around the marvellous areas of Tibia. There's everything - ice islands, deserts, jungles and mountains!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_15: [EN] The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_16: [EN] Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_17: [EN] Well, very important equipment would be a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Maybe also a torch if you're heading into a dark {dungeon}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_18: [EN] I sell fishing rods and worms in case you want to go fishing. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_19: [EN] You could check out which weapons I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_2: [EN] Buy and sell everything you want here!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_20: [EN] Oh, I'm sorry, that's one of the things I don't have for sale. But {Willie} or {Billy} surely have something to eat for you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_21: [EN] The king supports our little village very much!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_22: [EN] In the academy you can get a lot of information from books. You can also try out a few things by yourself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_23: [EN] Isn't it lovely here? You'll be surprised once you reach the {mainland} -  so much to explore!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_24: [EN] Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you've reached level 8 and talked to the {oracle}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_25: [EN] Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_26: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_27: [EN] Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_28: [EN] There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. If you want to know more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the guards.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_29: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. Apart from that, I also sell {footballs}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_3: [EN] No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_30: [EN] I really love flowers. My favourites are {honey flowers}. Sadly, they are very rare on this isle. If you can find one for me, I'll give you a little reward.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_31: [EN] You could check out which armors or shields I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_32: [EN] Yes, I'm selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_33: [EN] Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_34: [EN] He sells {weapons}. However, I can offer you better deals than him!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_35: [EN] I'm glad she stopped selling stuff. There was too much of a competition going on!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_36: [EN] Sometimes, I see him walking outside the village near some hole.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_37: [EN] He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_38: [EN] Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_39: [EN] Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_40: [EN] She lives under the {academy}. Always nice to chat with her!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_41: [EN] He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with premium adventurers, though.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_42: [EN] He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters carry also food such as meat. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_43: [EN] Visiting Cipfried in the {temple} is a good idea if you are injured or poisoned. He can heal you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_44: [EN] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}, just as I do.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_45: [EN] He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_46: [EN] She buys all {blueberries} and {cookies} you can find.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_47: [EN] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to reach more areas of {Tibia}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_48: [EN] He is the {bank} clerk, just below the academy.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_49: [EN] Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has a lot of important {information} about Tibia.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_50: [EN] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_51: [EN] He is a great warrior and our protector.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_52: [EN] Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_6: [EN] I'm a merchant. If you like to see my offers, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_8: [EN] Well, it's a good idea to leave most of your money in the bank and only take what you need. That way your gold is safe.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_9: [EN] Oh no! I've got to watch what I eat. {Lily} loves cookies, though.
npc.lee_delle.voice_1: [EN] Ask me if you need help!
npc.lee_delle.voice_2: [EN] Buy and sell everything you want here!
npc.lee_delle.voice_3: [EN] No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
npc.leeland.say_1: [EN] Oh yes, that project the whole dwarven community is so excited about. I guess I already know why you are here, but speak up.
npc.leeland.say_2: [EN] Oh yes, that project the whole dwarven community is so excited about. I guess I already know why you are here, but speak up. Do you want to try again?
npc.leeland.say_3: [EN] Your pathetic whimpering amuses me. For this I grant you my assistance. But listen, one day I'll ask you to return this favour. From now on, you owe me one.
npc.leeland.say_5: [EN] The idea of a promising market and new resources suits us quite well. I think it is reasonable to send some assistance.
npc.leeland.say_6: [EN] Oh yes, that project the whole dwarven community is so excited about. I guess I already know why you are here, but speak up.
npc.leeland.say_7: [EN] Oh yes, that project the whole dwarven community is so excited about. I guess I already know why you are here, but speak up.
npc.legola.stdmod_1: [EN] Teaching paladin spells! Just come to me!
npc.legola.voice_1: [EN] Teaching paladin spells! Just come to me!
npc.liane.farewell_msg_1: [EN] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.liane.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a trade if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.liane.say_1: [EN] I have more urgent problem to attend then that. Those hawks are hunting my carrier pigeons. Bring me 12 arrows and I'll see if I have the time for this nonsense. Do you have 12 arrows with you?
npc.liane.say_2: [EN] Great! Now I'll teach them a lesson ... For those measurements ... <tells you her measurements>
npc.liane.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.liane.voice_2: [EN] Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.
npc.liane.voice_3: [EN] If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
npc.liane.voice_4: [EN] No, no, no, there IS no parcel bug, I'm telling you!
npc.liane.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.lily.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh hey, |PLAYERNAME|! Vascalir must have sent you to help me with a little {mission}, right?
npc.lily.greet_msg_2: [EN] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Back so soon? Have you delivered the herbs to Hyacinth?
npc.lily.greet_msg_3: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! You look a little stressed today. If you like to view my offers of potions, just ask me for a {trade}. In case you're looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east!
npc.lily.kw_premium_1: [EN] If you purchase premium time for your account, this opens up a lot of possibilities. ...
npc.lily.kw_premium_2: [EN] For example, you will be able to travel off the mainland, ride a mount and benefit from offline training as well as having more outfits and magic spells to choose from.
npc.lily.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my offers. If you buy a potion, don't forget that there's a {deposit} of 5 gold on the empty flask.
npc.lily.stdmod_1: [EN] Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.stdmod_10: [EN] Is something... wrong? You didn't lose the herbs, did you?
npc.lily.stdmod_11: [EN] Well, at least you're honest. I can give you another sack, but only if you promise not to lose them this time. Okay?
npc.lily.stdmod_12: [EN] Phew. That's a relief. Well, don't forget to deliver them to Hyacinth! They have to be fresh to create potions.
npc.lily.stdmod_13: [EN] Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_14: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_15: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_16: [EN] How can I help you? If you like to buy something, just ask me for a {trade}. We can also chat about {Tibia}. Or, I could give you general {hints} about the game.
npc.lily.stdmod_17: [EN] You definitely need a good {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Also, you should never leave for a {dungeon} without {rope}, {shovel} and {torch}.
npc.lily.stdmod_18: [EN] I'm in tune with myself and with nature. Thank you.
npc.lily.stdmod_19: [EN] I'm a {druid}, bound to the spirit of nature. My {potions} will help you if you feel bad. I also buy {blueberries} and {cookies}. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_2: [EN] Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.stdmod_20: [EN] My name is Lily, like the flower. It also stands for purity, just like my {potions} are!
npc.lily.stdmod_21: [EN] It's about |TIME|. But does it really matter? Don't rush yourself and enjoy all these little moments.
npc.lily.stdmod_22: [EN] It's wise to store most of your gold at the bank below the academy. It's safer that way.
npc.lily.stdmod_23: [EN] If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
npc.lily.stdmod_24: [EN] Antidote potions will cure {poisoning}. They also have a lovely {blueberry} taste. You only need them when you get poisoned deep down in a dungeon, else just go to the {temple} for a free heal!
npc.lily.stdmod_25: [EN] Some creatures like snakes or poison spiders can poison you. That will diminish your health over a certain amount of time, so be careful when dealing with those creatures!
npc.lily.stdmod_26: [EN] Being a druid is a wonderful profession. You control the forces of nature and can heal others.
npc.lily.stdmod_27: [EN] There are many shops around here which are owned by local {citizens}.
npc.lily.stdmod_28: [EN] The temple is just to the right. You can get a healing for free there if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.lily.stdmod_29: [EN] Tibia is our beautiful world, created by the gods. Being a {druid}, I'm a worshipper of {Crunor}.
npc.lily.stdmod_3: [EN] Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.stdmod_30: [EN] Crunor is the great lord of trees and the creator of all plants. Despite what some people believe, he didn't create the {monsters}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_31: [EN] Oh, I'm sorry honey, I don't sell food. If you are hungry, visit one of the farmers {Billy} and {Willie}. I buy {blueberries} and {cookies}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_32: [EN] I can offer you homemade {antidote} potions and small {health} potions. Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see them.
npc.lily.stdmod_33: [EN] Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lily.stdmod_34: [EN] I think Tibia would be a better place without authorities who lead others to war. Can't we just all live in peace?
npc.lily.stdmod_35: [EN] The academy is the big stone building in the town centre. If you're ready to leave Rookgaard, go there to see the {oracle}.
npc.lily.stdmod_36: [EN] Well, in this village and its surroundings you can {train} your skills until you are level 8. Then you should see the {oracle} and head to the {main} continent.
npc.lily.stdmod_37: [EN] To train your skills, simply help us {fighting} monsters.
npc.lily.stdmod_38: [EN]  If you want to fight monsters, you should get better {equipment} from the {merchants}. You should also talk to one of the bridge {guards} to find suitable monsters for you.
npc.lily.stdmod_39: [EN] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.lily.stdmod_4: [EN] Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.stdmod_40: [EN] The main continent is huge! The gods of Tibia created everything from great seas, deep jungles and large deserts.
npc.lily.stdmod_41: [EN] Sadly, our little village of {Rookgaard} is invaded by monsters. From the {dungeons} they creep to the surface and attack the city. We always need adventurers helping us to {fight} them.
npc.lily.stdmod_42: [EN] If you are looking for weapons, you should visit {Obi}'s shop east of here. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_43: [EN] Armors? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_44: [EN] Shields? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_45: [EN] If you need information about the dungeons here, you should talk to one of the bridge {guards}. They will show you where to go.
npc.lily.stdmod_46: [EN] Our bridge guards are {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus}. You can find Dallheim if you follow the path to the right, then turn north at the {temple}.
npc.lily.stdmod_47: [EN] Yum, cookies! If you have some for me, just ask me for a trade.
npc.lily.stdmod_48: [EN] Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up what they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.lily.stdmod_49: [EN] I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_5: [EN] Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.stdmod_50: [EN] You best buy such equipment at {Al Dee}'s store in the North of the village. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_51: [EN] Oh yes, I love cookies! Will you accept 1 gold for it?
npc.lily.stdmod_53: [EN] Sorry, you do not have one.
npc.lily.stdmod_55: [EN] Oh, do you have blueberries for sale? I need them for my {antidote potion}. I give you 1 gold for 5 of them, yes?
npc.lily.stdmod_57: [EN] Oh, I'm sorry. I'm not buying less than 5 blueberries.
npc.lily.stdmod_59: [EN] He sells {weapons}. His shop is east of here.
npc.lily.stdmod_6: [EN] I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lily.stdmod_60: [EN] I don't know what to think about all this new bar. {Rookgaard} needs a little peace!
npc.lily.stdmod_61: [EN] He used to help me gather blueberries. Then, one day, he suddenly stopped comming here. They say he went a little out of his mind.
npc.lily.stdmod_62: [EN] We tried everything to fight that cockroach plague in his cellar, but natural anti-bug potions simply won't help. I guess those roaches need to be fought with stronger weapons.
npc.lily.stdmod_7: [EN] Oh. In that case, maybe you're interested in a {trade} - I sell potions and buy a few other things.
npc.lily.stdmod_77:
[EN] That's great to hear! You see, I'm not the only potion brewer on Rookgaard. The hermit Hyacinth has his little alchemy lab outside the village. ... \z
	He's old and can't make his way into the village anymore, but needs some of the herbs that grow only around here. Could you please deliver a bag of herbs to Hyacinth?
npc.lily.stdmod_78:
[EN] Here you go, honey. I really appreciate your help. To find Hyacinth, leave the village to the north and go pretty much straight to the east. ... \z
	His little alchemy lab is on top of a mountain. I'll mark the ramp leading up on your map, here. Don't stray from the path! There are dangerous monsters roaming the island.
npc.lily.stdmod_79:
[EN] Here you go, honey. I really appreciate your help. To find Hyacinth, leave the village to the north and go pretty much straight to the east. ... \z
	His little alchemy lab is on top of a mountain. I'll mark the ramp leading up on your map, here. Don't stray from the path! There are dangerous monsters roaming the island.
npc.lily.stdmod_8: [EN] Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_9: [EN] No, you haven't. If you're looking for the way to Hyacinth, just leave the village to the north and then go east. I've marked it on your map!
npc.lily.voice_1: [EN] Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.voice_2: [EN] Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.voice_3: [EN] Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.voice_4: [EN] Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.voice_5: [EN] Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.voice_6: [EN] I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lisander.greet_msg_1: [EN] I'd rather be left in {peace}. Keep it short.
npc.lisander.say_1: [EN] A cookie? Sure, is it for free?
npc.lisander.say_2: [EN] Whatever you have there, I think I don't want it.
npc.lisander.say_3: [EN] Errrkss - coughcough - what the - heck did you put in there? Get out of my sight!
npc.lizard_tunnel_guard.spotted: [EN] The guards have spotted you. You were forcibly dragged into a small cell. It looks like you need to build another disguise.
npc.lokur.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.lokur.say_1: [EN] Your weekly ticket is still valid. Would be a waste of money to purchase a second one
npc.lokur.say_2: [EN] Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
npc.lokur.say_4: [EN] Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.lokur.say_6: [EN] Come on, I have no clue what they are. Better ask my armorer Kroox for such nonsense.Go and ask him for good ol' Lokurs measurements, he'll know.
npc.lokur.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.lorbas.say_1: [EN] You want me to eat this cookie?
npc.lorbas.say_2: [EN] You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.lorbas.say_3: [EN] Well, you don't mind if I play around with this antidote rune a bit ... UHHH, YOU LOU ... uhm that was so ... funny, haha ... ha. Mhm, you better leave now.
npc.lorek.stdmod_1: [EN] Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.lorek.stdmod_3: [EN] I heard he is some scary magician or so.
npc.lorek.stdmod_4: [EN] I can travel you to west, centre, darama, chor or banuta.
npc.lorietta.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.lorietta.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_11: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_12: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_13: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_14: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_15: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_16: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_17: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_18: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_19: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_2: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_20: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_21: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_22: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_23: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_25:
[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_4: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_7: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_9: [EN] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.lorietta.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.lothar.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to my humble hut, |PLAYERNAME|. What brings you {here}?
npc.lothar.multi_1: [EN] The stampor in the back? She's my friend, but she came to me out of her own free will. I must admit I've never managed to tame any other stampor. ...
npc.lothar.multi_2: [EN] I heard that there's some sort of voodoo magic which would allow you to summon a stampor, but I'm not a voodoo expert, so I wouldn't know.
npc.lothar.multi_3: [EN] It is said that ferocious creatures once thrived on lush islands in the far northern sea. They died aeons ago when times of great cold came and formed the icy wastes of Svargrond as we know them today. ...
npc.lothar.multi_4: [EN] Travellers from the north have told stories of these creatures, watching them from within the ice in the deepest caves, still vigilant as if frozen in time. 'Ursagrodon' they called them. ...
npc.lothar.multi_5: [EN] With tinder and some kind of fireproof vessel, you could create a device to melt the ice surrounding their remains and see for yourself what this is all about.
npc.lothar.multi_6: [EN] Did you know that you can also create those by yourself? Trade a gold ingot with the sweaty cyclops in Ab'Dendriel for a cup of molten gold. If you use that on a fir tree, you have a small chance to get a golden fir cone. ...
npc.lothar.multi_7: [EN] Those are needed to impress the white deers that roam around Ab'Dendriel sometimes, but I'd wait until you are able to enrage one to make sure it has the necessary strength to carry you.
npc.lothar.multi_8: [EN] That's an interesting one, nothing like I have ever seen myself. What you describe is a device of which I heard that it grants literally 'complete' control over some sort of... artificial thing? ...
npc.lothar.multi_9: [EN] Well, if you ever happen to come about a stroke of luck and find such a thing - use it on an appropriate mount, it will probably be mechanical, driven by... something.
npc.lothar.stdmod_1: [EN] I enjoy the peace and solitude out here. You're welcome to be my guest as long as you behave in a quiet and tolerable manner.
npc.lothar.stdmod_10: [EN] I heard that terror birds really love carrots. I'd try waving it in front of one of those.
npc.lothar.stdmod_11: [EN] Ah, what a pretty ribbon. Reminds me of the elusive dragonlings - they're quite elegant and vain. They would probably welcome a decorative element. They're sometimes spotted during volcano eruptions.
npc.lothar.stdmod_12: [EN] What a neat little elvish gadget. Did you know a diapason works with vibrations to create sound? I actually think this could work on a creature made of crystals.
npc.lothar.stdmod_13: [EN] I'm against violence towards any creature. I've heard those barbarians in the desert use it for disobedient dromedaries.
npc.lothar.stdmod_14: [EN] Oh, what a nice little plant! Did you know it's supposed to bring luck? So is the lady bug. Both of them might actually go well together.
npc.lothar.stdmod_15: [EN] I've heard that there once was a gang of manta ray riders who liked to adorn their mantas with a foxtail. Don't ask me why, maybe they like how it floats in the wind when running really fast?
npc.lothar.stdmod_16: [EN] What a strange device! This looks like a tool for someone who creates golems and modifies living creatures. You could probably tame a modded creature with it, but I doubt they live in the wild.
npc.lothar.stdmod_17: [EN] Oh, that's one of the favourite foods of a crustacea gigantica. I think you can just distract it with the food and quickly jump on its back.
npc.lothar.stdmod_18: [EN] Have you ever encountered a magma crawler? They only eat and drink really hot things. You could probably try and make one drink some glow wine - and quickly mount it as long as it's drunk.
npc.lothar.stdmod_19: [EN] Hm. What an interesting find. This is definitely not used for any sort of animal. Maybe a vehicle? I can imagine it could be used for a bike of some sorts.
npc.lothar.stdmod_2: [EN] Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_20: [EN] That looks like it might fit a draptor. If you can ever get close enough to one to catch it, I'd simply try putting it on while whispering calming words.
npc.lothar.stdmod_21: [EN] The sound of a hunting horn is often intimidating to forest creatures, but I heard that wild boars actually like it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_22: [EN] Ironblights consist mainly of stone and iron. With a strong magnet like that you can basically force it to walk in the direction you're wanting it to.
npc.lothar.stdmod_23: [EN] Try catching a midnight panther using that one. Don't hit the panther, mind you. Just let the whip crack in the air - I think that will work.
npc.lothar.stdmod_24: [EN] As far as I know, leeches can be found in terrestrial, swampy areas. Leeches often help large animals such as water buffaloes to get rid of parasites.
npc.lothar.stdmod_25: [EN] You should show that giant jaw to a creature looking like the one you got it from. It will respect you when it sees those scary teeth.
npc.lothar.stdmod_26: [EN] Where did you get that? What a rare treat. This must have been crafted by someone who truly loves both music and animals. I can't tell you anything else about it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_27: [EN] Oh, a nail case..., I hate paring nails. But I heard gravediggers become trusting when they get the right treatment.
npc.lothar.stdmod_28: [EN] How impressive, a nightmare horn. Have you ever encountered a shock head? Try hypnotizing them with your horn.
npc.lothar.stdmod_29: [EN] You could probably ride a black sheep with these. Talk to it gently and carefully put on the reins.
npc.lothar.stdmod_3: [EN] Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_30: [EN] Wow, that's a rarity. Have you ever met one of those large sandstone scorpions? They're quite impressive. You need such a sceptre to show to one that you're its new master.
npc.lothar.stdmod_31: [EN] That might be the only way to tame a bear. It has a sensitive spot right between the ears which will calm it down, but you're not strong enough for simple acupressure. Using the slingshot is likely to help you with that.
npc.lothar.stdmod_32: [EN] As the name indicates - this can be used to make a slug much faster than it normally is! Once you've tamed it, it will race you wherever you want to go.
npc.lothar.stdmod_33: [EN] Create sugar oat by just mixing a bunch of sugar cane with a bunch of wheat. All horses love sugar oat! Sometimes when the horses from the horse station in Thais are on the loose, wild horses mix with the herd. Maybe they can be tamed?
npc.lothar.stdmod_34: [EN] The interesting part about that bait isn't the sweet stuff - it's the flies attracted to the sweet smell. Spiders love to eat flies, especially the Zaoan ones.
npc.lothar.stdmod_35: [EN] Hm! Now that's an interesting one. Where did you get that from? I could imagine it winds something up in a factory, but it's definitely not a normal animal.
npc.lothar.stdmod_4: [EN] I love all animals, whether small or big. I also believe each one, even the wildest and most ferocious being, can be talked to, understood and {tamed}.
npc.lothar.stdmod_5: [EN] It's my dream to shelter many different tamed animals. Maybe one day that dream will come true.
npc.lothar.stdmod_6: [EN] Well, usually you can tame animals with the help of a few simple items. If you've found such an {item}, show it to me and I might be able to help you with instructions on the taming process.
npc.lothar.stdmod_7: [EN] Well? Which item have you found and require advice for?
npc.lothar.stdmod_8: [EN] That's among the favourite foods of donkeys, as far as I know. It's a shame I haven't really seen any donkey around. It could require a magic trick to actually get to meet one.
npc.lothar.stdmod_9: [EN] Pandas love to eat bamboo leaves, but the Tiquandan pandas are actually not that skilled at climbing, so they have a hard time getting some for themselves. You might be able to tame one with them.
npc.lothar.voice_1: [EN] I enjoy the peace and solitude out here. You're welcome to be my guest as long as you behave in a quiet and tolerable manner.
npc.loui.farewell_msg_1: [EN] May the gods protect you! And stay away from that hole!
npc.loui.stdmod_10: [EN] They were so many, EVERYWHERE! I could barely escape alive. I have no clue what THEY were but one more second down there and I'd have been dead!
npc.loui.stdmod_11: [EN] Sorry, I'm out of mana and ingredients, please visit Cipfried in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_12: [EN] The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_13: [EN] Everything around us, that is Tibia.
npc.loui.stdmod_14: [EN] Most adventurers take their first steps there.
npc.loui.stdmod_15: [EN] Pah, king! He should do something about this {hole}!
npc.loui.stdmod_16: [EN] This is the place where everything starts.
npc.loui.stdmod_17: [EN] Was it...? Yes, I might have looked for blueberries as I foolishly entered this unholy {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_18: [EN] There must be an army of them, just down this {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_19: [EN] Then, they must be magic wielding beasts using creature illusion! Good thing you escaped.
npc.loui.stdmod_20: [EN] The gods blessed Tibia with abundant forms of life.
npc.loui.stdmod_21: [EN] The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_22: [EN] I have no quests but to stay away from that {hole} and I recommend you to do the same.
npc.loui.stdmod_23: [EN] I'm penniless and poor as becomes a humble monk like me.
npc.loui.stdmod_24: [EN] She owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_25: [EN] She owns a bar in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_26: [EN] Waaaah! Don't shock me like that!
npc.loui.stdmod_27: [EN] He has his own monsters, I believe.
npc.loui.stdmod_29: [EN] He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_3: [EN] What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!
npc.loui.stdmod_30: [EN] Who's that? Never heard about her.
npc.loui.stdmod_31: [EN] He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_33: [EN] The gods may protect me from his rudeness.
npc.loui.stdmod_34: [EN] A hermit on the other side of town.
npc.loui.stdmod_35: [EN] The oracle! Yes! You should get off this island as fast as you can!
npc.loui.stdmod_5: [EN] I'm a {monk}. I wanted to do something here, but I forgot what it was when I fell in that {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_6: [EN] I'm a humble servant of the {gods}.
npc.loui.stdmod_7: [EN] They created Tibia and all lifeforms.
npc.loui.stdmod_8: [EN] I have no idea how long I've been in this {hole}. It seemed like an eternity!
npc.loui.stdmod_9: [EN] While looking for something - which I forgot - I found that {hole}. I went down, even though I had no torch. And then I heard {THEM}! There must be dozens!
npc.loui.voice_3: [EN] What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!
npc.lubo.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to my adventurer shop, |PLAYERNAME|! What do you need? Ask me for a {trade} to look at my wares.
npc.lubo.say_1: [EN] Sorry, the backpack I wear is not for sale. It's handmade from rare minotaur leather.
npc.lubo.say_10: [EN] Great! Alright, I need a while to finish this backpack for you. Come ask me later, okay?
npc.lubo.say_11: [EN] I know, it's quite some work... don't lose heart, just keep killing minotaurs and you'll eventually get lucky. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?
npc.lubo.say_12: [EN] Ah yes, I remember my grandfather talking about that name. This house used to be an inn a long time ago. My family bought it from some of these flower guys.
npc.lubo.say_13: [EN] Oh, I mean druids of course. They sold the cottage to my family after some of them died in an accident or something like that.
npc.lubo.say_14: [EN] As far as I can remember the story, a pet escaped its stable behind the inn. It got somehow involved with powerful magic at a ritual and was transformed in some way.
npc.lubo.say_15: [EN] My grandpa told me, in the old days there were some behind this cottage. Nothing big though, just small ones, for chicken or rabbits.
npc.lubo.say_2: [EN] Ah, right, almost forgot about the backpack! Have you brought me 100 pieces of minotaur leather as requested?
npc.lubo.say_3: [EN] Just in time! Your backpack is finished. Here you go, I hope you like it.
npc.lubo.say_4: [EN] Uh... I didn't expect you to return that early. Sorry, but I'm not finished yet with your backpack. I'm doing the best I can, promised.
npc.lubo.say_5: [EN] Sorry, but I can only make one backpack per person, else I'd have to close my shop and open a leather manufactory.
npc.lubo.say_6: [EN] Well, if you really like this backpack, I could make one for you, but minotaur leather is hard to come by these days. Are you willing to put some work into this?
npc.lubo.say_7: [EN] Alright then, if you bring me 100 pieces of fine minotaur leather I will see what I can do for you. You probably have to kill really many minotaurs though... so good luck!
npc.lubo.say_8: [EN] Sorry, but I don't run a welfare office, you know... no pain, no gain.
npc.lubo.say_9: [EN] Sorry, but that's not enough leather yet to make one of these backpacks. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?
npc.lubo.stdmod_1: [EN] Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!
npc.lubo.stdmod_2: [EN] I am selling equipment for adventurers. If you need anything, let me know.
npc.lubo.stdmod_3: [EN] This is Ruffy my dog, please don't do him any harm.
npc.lubo.stdmod_4: [EN] I sell torches, fishing rods, worms, ropes, water hoses, backpacks, apples, and maps.
npc.lubo.stdmod_5: [EN] I am Lubo, the owner of this shop.
npc.lubo.stdmod_6: [EN] Oh! I'm sorry, I sold the last one just five minutes ago.
npc.lubo.stdmod_7: [EN] My hat? Hanna made this one for me.
npc.lubo.stdmod_8: [EN] Oh, you sure mean this old story about the mage Dago, who lost two fingers when he conjured a dragon.
npc.lubo.voice_1: [EN] Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!
npc.lugri.multi_1: [EN] You do? I mean - wise decision. Let me explain. By now, Tibia has been overrun by numerous followers of different cults and beliefs. The true Necromancers died or left Tibia long ago, shortly after their battle was lost. ...
npc.lugri.multi_10: [EN] What? Who are you to imply I need help from a worm like you? ...
npc.lugri.multi_11: [EN] I don't need help. But if you desperately wish to do something to earn the favour of Zathroth, feel free. Don't expect any reward though. ...
npc.lugri.multi_12: [EN] Do you want to help and serve Zathroth out of your own free will, without demanding payment or recognition?
npc.lugri.multi_2: [EN] What is left are mainly pseudo-dark pretenders, the old wisdom and power being far beyond their grasp. They think they have the right to tap that dark power, but they don't. ...
npc.lugri.multi_3: [EN] I want you to eliminate them. As many as you can. All of the upstart necromancer orders, and those priestesses. And as I said, don't expect a reward - this is what has to be done to cleanse Tibia of its false dark prophets.
npc.lugri.multi_4: [EN] Hrm. So you had the guts to enter that room. Well, it's all fake magic anyway and no real threat. ...
npc.lugri.multi_5: [EN] What are you looking at me for? Waiting for something? I told you that there was no reward. Despite being allowed to stand before me without being squashed like a bug. Get out of my sight!
npc.lugri.multi_7: [EN]  necromancers and priestesses. Still, you've shown some dedication. Maybe that means you can kill one of those so-called 'leaders' too. ...

npc.lugri.say_1: [EN] This skull shows that you are a true follower of Zathroth and the glorious gods of darkness. Are you willing to prove your loyalty?

npc.lugri.say_11: [EN] Good decision, |PLAYERNAME|. Your first sacrifice will be a medusa shield. Bring it to me and do give it happily.
npc.lugri.say_12: [EN] Good. I accept your sacrifice. The second sacrifice I require from you is a dragon scale mail. Bring it to me and do give it happily.

npc.lukosch.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
npc.lukosch.say_1: [EN] Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
npc.lukosch.say_2: [EN] Your weekly ticket is still valid. Would be a waste of money to purchase a second one
npc.lukosch.say_3: [EN] Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.luna.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, traveller. Maybe you'd like to take a look at my {offers}...
npc.luna.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.luna.stdmod_1: [EN] Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!
npc.luna.voice_1: [EN] Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!
npc.lurik.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to the {explorer society} headquarter of Svargrond, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.lurik.multi_1: [EN] Now we're talking! Maybe you've already heard of the island Okolnir south of Hrodmir. ...
npc.lurik.multi_10: [EN] We need you to recover this crystal. Travel to the southern camp of the raiders and find our contact man there. Get the memory crystal and bring ithere. The society and the shamans will then decide our next steps. Do you think you can do this?
npc.lurik.multi_11: [EN] Ah! You did it! I can't wait to hear the sound... but I will do that in a silent moment. ...
npc.lurik.multi_12: [EN] You helped as much in our research here. As a reward, you may use our astral portal in the upper room from now on. ...
npc.lurik.multi_13: [EN] For just one orichalcum pearl, you can travel between Liberty Bay and Svargrond. Thank you again!
npc.lurik.multi_14: [EN] Ah, yes, the mission. Let me tell you about something called ice music. ...
npc.lurik.multi_15: [EN] There is a cave on Hrodmir, north of the southernmost barbarian camp Krimhorn. ...
npc.lurik.multi_16: [EN] In this cave, there are a waterfall and a lot of stalagmites. ...
npc.lurik.multi_17: [EN] When the wind blows into this cave and hits the stalagmites, it is supposed to create a sound similar to a soft song. ...
npc.lurik.multi_18: [EN] Please take this resonance crystal and use it on the stalagmites in the cave to record the sound of the wind.
npc.lurik.multi_19: [EN] A frozen dragon lord? This is just the information we needed! And you even brought a scale from it! Take these 5000 gold pieces as a reward. ...
npc.lurik.multi_2: [EN] Okolnir is the home of a new and fierce dragon race, the so-called frost dragons. However, we have no idea where they originate from. ...
npc.lurik.multi_20: [EN] As you did such a great job, I might have another mission for you later.
npc.lurik.multi_3: [EN] Rumours say that dragon lords, that roamed on this isle, were somehow turned into frost dragons when the great frost covered Okolnir. ...
npc.lurik.multi_4: [EN] Travel to Okolnir and try to find a proof for the existence of dragon lords there in the old times. I think old Buddel might be able to bring you there.
npc.lurik.multi_5: [EN] The information was quite useful. What worries me most are not the raiders but those that have driven them from the old mines...
npc.lurik.multi_6: [EN] We need to investigate the mines. Most entrances collapsed due to the lack of maintenance but there should be some possibilities to get in ...
npc.lurik.multi_7: [EN] In case you find a door, Ill tell you the old trick of the Carlin mining company to open it <whisper> <whisper>. Find some hint or someone who is willing to talk about what is going on there.
npc.lurik.multi_8: [EN] You are the one who became an honorary barbarian! The one who made friends with the grim local musher and helped the shamans of Nibelor! The one they call old bearhugg ... erm ... I mean indeed I might have a mission for someone like you ...
npc.lurik.multi_9: [EN] We are trying to find out what is happening in the raider camps. Through our connection to the shamans we could get a covered contact in their majorcamp far to the south. We equipped our contact with a memory crystal so he could report all he knew ...
npc.lurik.say_1: [EN] Ah, you've just come in time. An experienced explorer is just what we need here! Would you like to go on a mission for us?
npc.lurik.say_3: [EN] Have you retrieved the memory crystal?
npc.lurik.say_5: [EN] Excellent. Just report about your mission when you got the memory crystal.
npc.lurik.say_6: [EN] Ah, great. Please give me some time to evaluate the information. Then talk to me again about your mission.
npc.lynda.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.lynda.multi_1: [EN] Thank you, I promise that your efforts won't be in vain! Listen closely now: First, I need a sample of five druid rods and five sorcerer wands. ...
npc.lynda.multi_10: [EN] Will you gather them for me?
npc.lynda.multi_2: [EN] I need a snakebite rod, a moonlight rod, a necrotic rod, a terra rod and a hailstorm rod. Then, I need a wand of vortex, a wand of dragonbreath ...
npc.lynda.multi_3: [EN] ... a wand of decay, a wand of cosmic energy and a wand of inferno. Please bring them all at once so that their energy will be balanced. ...
npc.lynda.multi_4: [EN] Secondly, I need 10 ounces of magic sulphur. It can absorb the elemental energy of all the wands and rods and bind it to something else. ...
npc.lynda.multi_5: [EN] Next, I will need a soul stone. These can be used as a vessel for energy, evil as well as good. They are rarely used nowaday though. ...
npc.lynda.multi_6: [EN] Lastly, I need a lot of holy energy. I can extract it from ankhs, but only a small amount each time. I will need about 20 ankhs. ...
npc.lynda.multi_7: [EN] Did you understand everything I told you and will help me with my blessing?
npc.lynda.multi_8: [EN] Angelina had been imprisoned? My, these are horrible news, but I am so glad to hear that she is safe now. ...
npc.lynda.multi_9: [EN] I will happily carry out her wish and reward you, but I fear I need some important ingredients for my blessing spell first. ...

npc.maealil.greet_1: [EN] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.maealil.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.maealil.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.maealil.stdmod_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.maealil.stdmod_11: [EN] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake.
npc.maealil.stdmod_12: [EN] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.maealil.stdmod_13: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Peace may fill your soul - evil shall be cleansed'. Now, bring your stake to Yberius in the Venore temple for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.maealil.stdmod_15: [EN] You should visit Yberius in the Venore temple now.
npc.maealil.stdmod_16: [EN] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.maealil.stdmod_17: [EN] A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.maealil.stdmod_18: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.maealil.stdmod_19: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.maealil.stdmod_2: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.maealil.stdmod_20: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.maealil.stdmod_21: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.maealil.stdmod_22: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.maealil.stdmod_23: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.maealil.stdmod_24: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.maealil.stdmod_25: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.maealil.stdmod_26: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.maealil.stdmod_27: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.maealil.stdmod_28: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.maealil.stdmod_29: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.maealil.stdmod_30: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.maealil.stdmod_34:
[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.maealil.stdmod_4: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.maealil.stdmod_7: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.maealil.stdmod_9: [EN] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.maealil.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.maelyrra.farewell_msg_1: [EN] May your path always be even.
npc.maelyrra.greet_msg_1: [EN] Nature's blessings! Welcome to the land of dreams.
npc.maelyrra.multi_1: [EN] That's wonderful! Now you will be able to repair the magical barrier. You have to strengthen the arcane sources that power this mystic shield. There are three different arcane sources: the moon sculptures, the dream bird trees and the sun mosaics. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_10: [EN] They are living in tunnels and caves but at night they surface, even attacking their own siblings. They kidnapped some fairies, holding them prisoner in their mouldy dens. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_11: [EN] And as if this wasn't enough they stole an ancient and precious artefact, the moon mirror. Please seek out the tainted fae, retrieve the artefact and free the captured fairies. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_12: [EN] You may discover the entrance to the tainted caves somewhere in the deep forest. The tainted fae like to hide their treasures in hollow logs or trumps, so have a closer look at them.
npc.maelyrra.multi_2: [EN] There are five of each of them and you have to find them all to repair the barrier. Spread the gathered moon rays on the moon sculptures. Pour out the starlight over the dream bird trees and let the sunlight shine on the mosaics. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_3: [EN] If you charge all fifteen arcane sources with the respective light, Feyrist's protection will be ensured again.
npc.maelyrra.multi_4: [EN] Very good, mortal being! Now you have to catch the respective light and store it in the corresponding vessel. You can gather moon rays by night but this will only work on one special sacred glade on Feyrist. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_5: [EN] You can find this glade in the deep forest, east of our village. The starlight must also be gathered by night. There is a rock plateau high in the mountains at the border to Roshamuul where you can catch the starlight in the vial. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_6: [EN] You will recognise the place by the elemental energy shrine there. You have to gather the sunlight by day, of course. There is a beach in the north of Feyrist, shaped like a snake's head. There you may gather Suon's light with the sun catcher.
npc.maelyrra.multi_7: [EN] You have to find three vessels that are able to hold three different types of light: starlight, sunlight and moon rays. You have already found the moon mirror but we also need the starlight vial and the sun catcher. ...
npc.maelyrra.multi_8: [EN] Ask the mermaid Aurita for the starlight vial and the faun Taegen for the sun catcher.
npc.maelyrra.multi_9: [EN] Some of our siblings are tainted by the destructive energies that threaten Feyrist. They are darker now, more aggressive, twisted ... I'm sure you already met them. ...
npc.maelyrra.say_1: [EN] Some annoying nightmarish creatures rove about in the tunnels underneath this island. They are threatening the members of my court and devastate the flora and fauna. They also threaten the natural balance. Would you go and fight them for me?
npc.maelyrra.say_10: [EN] You rendered a great favour to the fae courts and Feyrist alike. Would you help us with another problem?
npc.maelyrra.say_11: [EN] You have to kill two hundred of nightmare creatures and the terrible demon Kroazur who's leading them. That should bring some relief for the fae.
npc.maelyrra.say_12: [EN] Thank you, mortal being! Please keep the mirror. I think you may need it soon, because there is another problem. Would you help us again?
npc.maelyrra.say_13: [EN] Please keep the mirror. I think you may need it soon, because there is another problem. Would you help us again?
npc.maelyrra.say_14: [EN] Please seek out the tainted fae, retrieve the artefact and free the captured fairies.
npc.maelyrra.say_15: [EN] You have to catch the respective lights and store it in the corresponding vessel.
npc.maelyrra.say_16: [EN] Thank you, mortal being! The fae will be forever grateful. Take this blossom bag as a little thank-you gift. Such blossoms grow on our trees just once in a decade, so they are quite rare.
npc.maelyrra.say_17: [EN] If you charge all fifteen arcane sources with the respective light, Feyrist's protection will be ensured again.
npc.maelyrra.say_2: [EN] Have you defeated the nightmare monsters?
npc.maelyrra.say_3: [EN] Have you found the moon mirror and freed the captured fairies?
npc.maelyrra.say_4: [EN] Have you already found the starlight vial and the sun catcher?
npc.maelyrra.say_5: [EN] Could you already gather the three lights?
npc.maelyrra.say_6: [EN] Have you repaired the magical barrier? Is Feyrist safe?
npc.maelyrra.say_7: [EN] Thank you again, mortal being! The fae will be forever grateful.
npc.maelyrra.say_8: [EN] I knew you would be willing to help us. Kill two hundred of them as well as the terrible demon Kroazur who's leading them. That should bring some relief for the fae.
npc.maelyrra.say_9: [EN] Thank you! You rendered a great favour to the fae courts and Feyrist alike. Would you help us with another problem?
npc.maelyrra.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] May your path always be even.
npc.maeryn.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, visitor. I wonder what may lead you to this {dangerous} place.
npc.maeryn.multi_1: [EN] Every month around the 13th, the single Tibian moon will by fully visible to us. That's when the curse hits us hardest. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_10: [EN] Those merely wounded, first thought they were lucky. But then we realised they were changing, too. Later, others assumed the forms of badgers and boars also. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_11: [EN] But that does not mean they were any less wild or dangerous than the others.
npc.maeryn.multi_2: [EN] We do not know what happens down there in those tunnels around that time but there is a presence there, we all feel - yet cannot quite fathom. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_3: [EN] At full moon, humans transform into wild beasts: wolves, boars, bears and others. Some call it the {curse} of the Full Moon, others think it is a kind of sickness. .
npc.maeryn.multi_4: [EN] During this time, we try to not leave the house, we shut the windows and hope it will pass. The curse will weaken a bit after that but it returns. Every month.
npc.maeryn.multi_5: [EN] During this time, we try to not leave the house, we shut the windows and hope it will pass. The curse will weaken a bit after that but it returns. Every month.
npc.maeryn.multi_6: [EN] We are not sure what they are doing down there. We're glad if they stay in the caverns and leave us alone. Only at full moon do they come up and threaten the island's surface and village. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_7: [EN] I, however, have a {hunch} as to why they dwell so deep under the earth.
npc.maeryn.multi_8: [EN] It transforms peaceful villagers into savage beasts. We're not sure how this curse found the way into our small village. But one day it began. At first it befell just a few people. ...
npc.maeryn.multi_9: [EN] In a full moon night they changed into bears and wolves, and tore apart their unsuspecting relatives while they were asleep. ...
npc.maeryn.say_10: [EN] I'm the protector of this little village. A bit of a self-proclaimed function, I admit, but someone has to watch over {Grimvale}. It is a {dangerous} place.
npc.maeryn.say_11: [EN] The small island you are standing on. For a long time it was a peaceful and placid place. But lately it has become more {dangerous}.
npc.maeryn.say_12: [EN] He's an experienced hunter and knows much about the woods, the animals that dwell there, and about the {werewolves}. He's devoted himself to finding out everything there is to know about the {Curse}.
npc.maeryn.say_13: [EN] Yes, my friend, werewolves. They dwell here on {Grimvale}, threatening our life. The were-sickness transforms peaceful villagers into savage beasts. We're not sure how this curse found its way into our small village. But undoubtedly it did.
npc.maeryn.say_14: [EN] She's an old druid. She's been living here on {Grimvale} since she was a little girl, just like me. She's very interested in were-creature body parts. If you find any, I'm sure she will love to trade with you.
npc.maeryn.say_15: [EN] He's basically a ferryman nowadays, but I remember when he was our village's leading fisherman. He offers a ferry service between Grimvale and Edron. You must have met him - he sailed you here.
npc.maeryn.say_16: [EN] You brought the wolven helmet, as i see. Do you want to change something?
npc.maeryn.say_17: [EN] So, which profession would you give preference to when enchanting the helmet: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {druid} or {paladin}?
npc.maeryn.say_18: [EN] And what would be your preferred weapon? {Club}, {axe} or {sword}
npc.maeryn.say_19: [EN] So this is your choice. If you want to change it, you will have to come to me again.
npc.maeryn.say_2: [EN] Yes, pitiful. For they are savage beasts now who regularly come up from below to attack the village. But once they were inhabitants of Grimvale, before they {changed}.
npc.maeryn.say_20: [EN] Message when player do not have quest.
npc.maeryn.say_21: [EN] So this is your choice. If you want to change it, you will have to come to me again.
npc.maeryn.say_22: [EN] Message when player do not have quest.
npc.maeryn.say_23: [EN] So you don't know it yet. This island, Grimvale, is affected by were-sickness. Many {pitiful}, who are stricken with the curse, dwell in the {tunnels} and caverns underneath the village and the nearby hurst.
npc.maeryn.say_24: [EN] Yes, pitiful. For they are savage beasts now who regularly come up from below to attack the village. But once they were inhabitants of Grimvale, before they {changed}.
npc.maeryn.say_25: [EN] Through a bite or even a scratch, you may be infected with the were-sickness. If that happens, there is little {hope} - until the next full moon you'll change into a were-creature, depending on the animal that hurt you.
npc.maeryn.say_26: [EN] There is a plant, the purple nightshade. It blossoms exclusively in the light of the full moon and only underground, where the full moon's light is falling through fissures in the surface. Only this plant's blossoms are able to defeat the {were-sickness}.
npc.maeryn.say_27: [EN] It transforms peaceful villagers into savage beasts. We're not sure how this curse found the way into our small village. But one day it began. At first it befell just a few people. ...
npc.maeryn.say_28: [EN] In a full moon night they changed into bears and wolves, and tore apart their unsuspecting relatives while they were asleep. ...

npc.maeryn.say_32: [EN] I, however, have a {hunch} as to why they dwell so deep under the earth.
npc.maeryn.say_33: [EN] There are old legends about a subterranean temple that was once built in this area. Supposedly many {artefacts} are still hidden down there. ...
npc.maeryn.say_34: [EN] I don't have the time to tell you the entire tale, but there is a book downstairs in which you may read the whole story.
npc.maeryn.say_35: [EN] Yes, the story goes that there are ancient artefacts still hidden in the temple ruins, such as helmets in the form of wolven heads, for example. It is said that moonlight crystals are needed to enchant these artefacts.
npc.maeryn.say_36: [EN] Every month around the 13th, the single Tibian moon will by fully visible to us. That's when the curse hits us hardest. ...
npc.maeryn.say_37: [EN] The two days around the 13th, the 12th and the 14th, are considered 'Harvest Moon', those are the best to gather {nightshade}. However, only after it has reached its apex on the 13th, the curse strengthens. ...

npc.maeryn.say_40: [EN] During this time, we try to not leave the house, we shut the windows and hope it will pass. The curse will weaken a bit after that but it returns. Every month.
npc.maeryn.say_41: [EN] Three of these blossoms should suffice to heal some afflicted persons. But if you bring more I'd be grateful, of course.
