npc.sven.greet_msg_2: [EN] Iskan told me that you killed huskies here in Svargrond. I will be lenient towards you and won't ban you from Svargrond. But you have to pay me a compensation of 1500 gold for each husky you have killed. Are you willing to pay {}?
npc.sven.multi_1: [EN] Good, but to make barbarian mead we need some honey which is rare here. I'd hate to waste mead just to learn you're not worth it ...
npc.sven.multi_10: [EN] Return to me and talk about the {mammoth} pushing when you are done.
npc.sven.multi_11: [EN] An impressive start. Here, take your own mead horn to fill it at the mead bucket as often as you like ...
npc.sven.multi_12: [EN] But there is much left to be done. Your next test will be to hug a bear ...
npc.sven.multi_13: [EN] You will find one in a cave north of the town. If you are lucky, it's still sleeping. If not ... well that might hurt ...
npc.sven.multi_14: [EN] Unless you feel that you hugged the bear, the test is not passed. Once you are done, talk to me about the bear hugging.
npc.sven.multi_15: [EN] All of our juveniles have to take the barbarian test to become a true member of our community. Foreigners who manage to master the test are granted the title of an honorary barbarian and the respect of our people ...
npc.sven.multi_16: [EN] Are you willing to take the barbarian test?
npc.sven.multi_2: [EN] Therefore, you have to get your own honey. You'll probably need more than one try so better get some extra honeycombs. Then talk to me again about barbarian {mead}.
npc.sven.multi_3: [EN] That's the spirit! The barbarian test consists of a few tasks you will have to fulfill. All are rather simple - for a barbarian that is...
npc.sven.multi_4: [EN] Your first task is to drink some barbarian mead. But be warned, it's a strong brew that could even knock out a bear. You need to make at least ten sips of mead in a row without passing out to pass the test ...
npc.sven.multi_5: [EN] Do you think you can do this?
npc.sven.multi_6: [EN] As you have passed all three tests, I welcome you in our town as an honorary barbarian. You can now become a citizen. Don't forget to talk to the people here. Some of them might need some help ...
npc.sven.multi_7: [EN] We usually solve our problems on our own but some of the people might have a mission for you. Old Iskan, on the ice in the northern part of the town had some trouble with his dogs lately.
npc.sven.multi_8: [EN] Amazing. That was as clever and brave as a barbarian is supposed to be. But a barbarian also has to be strong and fearless. To prove that you will have to knock over a mammoth ...
npc.sven.multi_9: [EN] Did your face just turn into the color of fresh snow? However, you will find a lonely mammoth north west of the town in the wilderness. Knock it over to prove to be a true barbarian ...
npc.sven.say_1: [EN] I don't know if you realise the consequences. You won't be a member of our community anymore. I ask you for the last time: Are you willing to pay {} gold as a compensation?
npc.sven.say_2: [EN] Do you have some honey with you?
npc.sven.say_4: [EN] You don't have enough. Bring me the money and I will forget about it.
npc.sven.say_5: [EN] Good, for this honeycomb I allow you 20 sips from the mead bucket over there. Talk to me again about barbarian mead if you have passed the test.
npc.sven.say_6: [EN] Alright, it's your choice. If you regret your decision and want to be a barbarian again, talk to me about the {barbarian} test.
npc.sven.say_7: [EN] I don't know if you realise the consequences. You won't be a member of our community anymore. I ask you for the last time: Are you willing to pay {} gold as a compensation?

npc.swolt.say_1: [EN] Here you go. {} rice balls. Hope you buy a beer with them at least.
npc.swolt.say_2: [EN] You don't have a ripe rice plant. Thank fire and earth I was spared.
npc.swolt.say_3: [EN] Here you go. {} rice balls. Hope you buy a beer with them at least.
npc.swolt.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Take a look, but not a sip before you've paid. And I hope it stays like this and you don't get any strange ideas about {rice}.
npc.swolt.stdmod_1: [EN] Well, you see me standing behind a bar. Selling drinks. Food. And stuff. Now try figuring out what I could be making a living of down here.
npc.swolt.stdmod_2: [EN] I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. And as drinks we serve beer and water. If you'd like to see what we have to offer, just ask me for a trade.
npc.taegen.multi_1: [EN] I don't have any gems. If you bring me some, I can craft a sun catcher for you. Do you have gems?
npc.taegen.multi_10: [EN] Have you found some raven herb?
npc.taegen.multi_11: [EN] Thank you! We are so happy. Now Aurita can take a walk on the beach. And I can visit her secret underwater grotto.
npc.taegen.multi_12: [EN] We are so happy. Now Aurita can take a walk on the beach. But I still can't visit her secret underwater grotto. To achieve this, we need something else: a very rare plant called raven herb. ...
npc.taegen.multi_13: [EN] If eaten it allows an air breathing creature to breathe underwater for a while. Please find this plant for me. But know that you'll only find it at night. It resembles a common fern but its leaves are of a lighter green.
npc.taegen.multi_14: [EN] There is a fairy who once told me about this spell. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
npc.taegen.multi_15: [EN] Yes, there is something. It's a bit embarassing, you must promise not to tell anyone else. I'm in love with Aurita. Well, that wouldn't be a reson to be ashamed, but she is a mermaid. ...
npc.taegen.multi_16: [EN] A faun on the other hand is inhabiting the forests, dancing with fairies and, well, nymphs. But I lost my heart to the lovely Aurita. I can't help it. We would love to spend some time together, but not just sitting on the beach. ...
npc.taegen.multi_17: [EN] I'd love to show her the deep forest I love so much. I have an idea but I can't do it alone. Would you help me?
npc.taegen.multi_2: [EN] Alright, I will craft a sun catcher for you.
npc.taegen.multi_3: [EN] I already crafted one sun catcher for you.
npc.taegen.multi_4: [EN] Please find this plant for me. But know that you'll only find it at night. It resembles a common fern but its leaves are of a lighter green.
npc.taegen.multi_5: [EN] Thank you, friend! Now I can visit Aurita in her underwater grotto!
npc.taegen.multi_6: [EN] That's very kind of you, my friend! Listen: I know there is a spell to transform her fishtail into legs. It is a temporary effect, so she could return to the ocean as soon as the spell ends. Unfortunately I don't know how to cast this spell. ...
npc.taegen.multi_7: [EN] But there is a fairy who once told me about it. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
npc.taegen.multi_8: [EN] Thank you again, mortal being. A sun catcher is similar to a dream catcher but other than the latter it can preserve sunlight rather than bad dreams. I can craft one out of enchanted branches of a fairy tree as well as several enchanted gems. ...
npc.taegen.multi_9: [EN] The branches are no problem, I will find some in the forest. But I don't have any gems. If you bring me some, I can craft a sun catcher for you. Do you have gems?
npc.taegen.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Im carving bolts and arrows and i also craft bows anda spears.If you'd like to buy some ammunition, take a look.
npc.taegen.voice_1: [EN] Id like to take a walk with Aurita.
npc.taegen.voice_3: [EN] Pas in boldly tyll thow com to an hall the feyrist undir sky ... *sings*
npc.talila.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Yes, i have some potions and runes if you are interested. Or do you want to buy only potions or only runes?oh if you want sell or buy gems, your may also ask me.

npc.talphion.say_1: [EN] DRESS FLATTEN? WHO WANTS ME TO FLATTEN A DRESS?
npc.talphion.say_2: [EN] A PRESS LANTERN? NEVER HEARD ABOUT IT!
npc.talphion.say_4: [EN] A PATTERN IN THIS MESS?? HEY DON'T INSULT MY MACHINE HALL!
npc.talphion.say_5: [EN] AH YES! I WORKED ON THE DRESS PATTERN FOR THOSE UNIFORMS. STAINLESS TROUSERES, STEAM DRIVEN BOOTS! ANOTHERMARVEL TO BEHOLD! I'LL SENT A COPY TO KEVIN IMEDIATELY!
npc.tamerin.multi_1: [EN] Why should I do something for another human being? I have been on my own for all those years. Hmm, but actually there is something I could need some assistance with. ...
npc.tamerin.multi_2: [EN] If you help me to solve my problems, I will help you with your mission. Do you accept?
npc.tamerin.say_1: [EN] You have kept your promise. Now, it's time to fulfil my part of the bargain. What kind of animals shall I raise? {Warbeasts} or {cattle}?
npc.tamerin.say_2: [EN] Thank you very much. As I said, as soon as you have helped me to solve both of my problems, we will talk about your mission. Have you killed {morik}?
npc.tamerin.say_3: [EN] Come back when you have the cure.
npc.tamerin.say_6: [EN] So he finally got what he deserved. As I said, as soon as you have helped me to solve both of my problems, we will talk about your {mission}.
npc.tamerin.say_7: [EN] Come back when you got rid with Morik.
npc.tamerin.say_8: [EN] I ask you for two things! For one thing, I need an animal cure and for another thing, I ask you to get rid of the gladiator Morik for me.
npc.tamoril.date_restriction: [EN] You can only discuss the First Dragon between January 14 and February 12.
npc.tamoril.greet_msg_1: [EN] Another pesky mortal who believes his gold outweighs his nutrition value.
npc.tamoril.multi_1: [EN] So listen: The lairs are secluded and you can only reach them by using a magical gem teleporter. You will find a teleporter carved out of a giant emerald in the dragon lairs deep beneath the Darama desert, which will lead you to Tazhadur's lair. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_10: [EN] These incitements are also a kind of trial that has to be undergone if one wants to {find} the First Dragon's four descendants.
npc.tamoril.multi_2: [EN] A ruby teleporter located in the western Dragonblaze Peaks allows you to enter the lair of Kalyassa. A teleporter carved out of sapphire is on the island Okolnir and leads you to Gelidrazah's lair. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_3: [EN] And finally an amethyst teleporter in undead-infested caverns underneath Edron allows you to enter the lair of Zorvorax.
npc.tamoril.multi_4: [EN]  Fine! I'll tell you where to find our ancestors. You now may ask yourself why I should want you to go there and fight them. It's quite simple: I am a straight descendant of Kalyassa herself. She was not really a caring mother. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_5: [EN] No, she called herself an empress and behaved exactly like that. She was domineering, farouche and conceited and this finally culminated in a serious quarrel between us. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_6: [EN] I sought support by my aunt and my uncles but they were not a bit better than my mother was! So, feel free to go to their lairs and challenge them. I doubt you will succeed but then again that's not my problem. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_7: [EN] So, you want to know about their secret lairs?
npc.tamoril.multi_8: [EN] Each kind of dragon has its own incitement, an important aspect that impels them and occupies their mind. For the common dragons this is the lust for power, for the dragon lords the greed for treasures. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_9: [EN] The frost dragons' incitement is the thirst for knowledge und for the undead dragons it's the desire for life, as they regret their ancestor's mistake. ...
npc.tamoril.say_1: [EN] The First Dragon? The first of all of us? The Son of Garsharak? I'm surprised you heard about him. It is such a long time that he wandered Tibia. Yet, there are some {rumours}.
npc.tamoril.say_2: [EN] It is told that the First Dragon had four {descendants}, who became the ancestors of the four kinds of dragons we know in Tibia. They perhaps still have knowledge about the First Dragon's whereabouts - if one could find them.
npc.tamoril.say_3: [EN] The names of these four are Tazhadur, Kalyassa, Gelidrazah and Zorvorax. Not only were they the ancestors of all dragons after but also the primal representation of the {draconic incitements}. About whom do you want to learn more?
npc.tamoril.say_4: [EN] What do you want to do, if you know about these mighty dragons' abodes? Go there and look for a fight?

npc.tarak_sunken.greet_msg_1: [EN] Want to go back to Yalahar? Just ask me for a free {passage}.
npc.tarak_sunken.say_1: [EN] Do you want to go back to {Yalahar}?
npc.tarun.multi_1: [EN] So, he is dead as I feared. I warned him not to go with this woman, but he gave in to temptation. My heart darkens and moans. But you have my sincere thanks. ...
npc.tarun.multi_2: [EN] Without your help I would have stayed in the dark about his fate. Please, take this as a little recompense.
npc.tarun.multi_3: [EN] My brother is missing. I fear, he went to this evil palace north of here. A place of great beauty, certainly filled with riches and luxury. But in truth it is a threshold to hell and demonesses are after his blood. ...
npc.tarun.multi_4: [EN] He is my brother, and I am deeply ashamed to admit but I don't dare to go there. Perhaps your heart is more courageous than mine. Would you go to see this place and search for my brother?
npc.tarun.say_1: [EN] I hope you will find my brother.
npc.tarun.say_2: [EN] I thank you! This is more than I could hope!
npc.tarun.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just have a look.
npc.tefrit.say_1: [EN] Could you help me do a ritual?
npc.tefrit.say_2: [EN] Here is the list with the missing ingredients to complete the ritual.
npc.tefrit.say_4: [EN] Did you bring all the materials I informed you about?
npc.tefrit.say_5: [EN] Thank you this stage of the ritual is complete.
npc.tehlim.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello. I'm so glad someone has found me. Did you meet THEM?!
npc.tehlim.say_1: [EN] I warn you, those trolls are WAY more dangerous than the usual kind. Alone, I can't do anything for my brothers. Find a way to the trolls' hideout and rescue my brothers. Are you willing to help me?
npc.tehlim.say_2: [EN]  Great! I hope you find my brothers. Good luck!
npc.telas.say_1: [EN] I have heard only little about this mine. I am a bit absorbed in my studies. But what does this mine have to do with me?
npc.telas.say_2: [EN] You are starting this discussion again? Why should I listen to you this time, do you have anything to convince me to let you even try?
npc.telas.say_3: [EN] Well it sounds like a good idea to test my golems in some real environment. I think it is acceptable to send some of them to Farmine.
npc.telas.say_4: [EN] Well, of course my worker golems are quite usefull and it might indeed be a good idea to see who they operate on realistic conditions. I will send some to farmine soon.
npc.telas.say_5: [EN] Well, if the situation is that desperate I think it is possible to send some of the golems to help the poor dwarfs out of their misery.
npc.telas.say_6: [EN] Oh how nice of you. I might have misjudged you. So let us return to this matter of worker golems. Do you have any better arguments this time?
npc.tereban.cloth_deliver: [EN] Could you find the cloth I am looking for?
npc.tereban.cloth_done: [EN] Thanks to your efforts we have a suitable piece of spectral cloth.
npc.tereban.cloth_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. You will find it somewhere in the crypts under the Isle of the Kings. You will probably have to look for hidden caves when you don't find it at an obvious place. Perhaps you even need a shovel or a pick.
npc.tereban.cloth_no: [EN] Don't forget, you will find it somewhere in the crypts under the Isle of the Kings. You will probably have to look for hidden caves when you don't find it at an obvious place. Perhaps you even need a shovel or a pick.
npc.tereban.cloth_success: [EN] It looks a bit scary but I guess sorcerers might even find that appealing. Thank you very much.
npc.tereban.crystal_deliver: [EN] Did you find the required crystal?
npc.tereban.crystal_done: [EN] The crystal you have found is absolutely flawless. You did a great job indeed.
npc.tereban.crystal_failure_1: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. It is probably not easy to find the crystal that we need in such a huge desert which may contain several tombs, but please don't give up. ...
npc.tereban.crystal_failure_2: [EN] According to my sources the tomb we are looking for is east of Ankrahmun. You probably need a shovel to enter it. We still have some time and I am convinced you will find it.
npc.tereban.crystal_no_1: [EN] It is probably not easy to find the crystal that we need in such a huge desert which may contain several tombs, but please don't give up. ...
npc.tereban.crystal_no_2: [EN] According to my sources the tomb we are looking for is east of Ankrahmun. You probably need a shovel to enter it. We still have some time and I am convinced you will find it.
npc.tereban.crystal_success: [EN] Oh look at the colours and sparkles. This crystal is truly remarkable, thank you.
npc.tereban.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, friend. Good you are showing up.
npc.tereban.iron_deliver: [EN] Have you found the iron that we need for the present?
npc.tereban.iron_done: [EN] The iron that you've found will make an ideal base for a shield.
npc.tereban.iron_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. I know it's not easy to find this iron but there has to be some in the deposits beneath the old Kazordoon mines. I doubt that it can be found in the newer mines outside of Kazordoon.
npc.tereban.iron_no: [EN] I know it's not easy to find this iron but there has to be some in the deposits beneath the old Kazordoon mines. I doubt it that it can be found in the newer mines outside of Kazordoon.
npc.tereban.iron_success: [EN] I wish there'd an easier way to get that iron but those dwarfs are so stubborn. However, now we got what we need.
npc.tereban.root_deliver: [EN] Could you find the root which we are looking for?
npc.tereban.root_done: [EN] It is even recognisable for me that the root you gave me is filled with magic.
npc.tereban.root_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. The best advice I can give you is to look underground beneath the city for a suitable root.
npc.tereban.root_no: [EN] The best advice I can give you is to look underground beneath the city for a suitable root.
npc.tereban.root_success: [EN] You are admirably determined in fulfilling your task. I will make sure that my sons appreciate what you did for their presents.
npc.tereban.scale_deliver: [EN] Could you get Glitterscale's scales yet?
npc.tereban.scale_done: [EN] Only someone as daring as you could slay the beast to get the necessary scales.
npc.tereban.scale_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. Oh please, search for Glitterscale. It should not be too hard to find it in those caves north of Thais.
npc.tereban.scale_no: [EN] Oh please, search for Glitterscale. It should not be too hard to find it in those caves north of Thais.
npc.tereban.scale_success: [EN] These scales must have belonged to a fearsome beast. I envy you for your bravery.
npc.tereban.silk_deliver: [EN] So you've found the silk that I need?
npc.tereban.silk_done: [EN] The silk you have brought me is exquisite indeed.
npc.tereban.silk_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. Search the spider caves of the continent Zao for the silk. They have to be somewhere in the east of Zao's southern part. My sources claim there you will find the silk that we need.
npc.tereban.silk_no: [EN] Then search the spider caves of the continent Zao for the silk. They have to be somewhere in the east of Zao's southern part. My sources claim there you will find the silk that we need.
npc.tereban.silk_success: [EN] Great. I better don't think about how big a spider has to be to produce such strands of silk.
npc.tereban.sinew_deliver: [EN] Do you have the required sinew?
npc.tereban.sinew_done: [EN] Your bravery earned us this excellent sinew.
npc.tereban.sinew_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. Perhaps Heoni was out to hunt when you were looking for it. Search in the mountains of Edron. I put my trust in your abilities.
npc.tereban.sinew_no: [EN] Perhaps Heoni was out to hunt when you were looking for it. Search in the mountains of Edron. I put my trust in your abilities.
npc.tereban.sinew_success: [EN] Ah, not only did you bring some sinew to me, you also made the world a safer place by killing Heoni.
npc.tereban.wood_deliver: [EN] Could you find the wood we were talking about?
npc.tereban.wood_done: [EN] The wood you have found is just what we needed.
npc.tereban.wood_failure_1: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. The wood that I need should be in one of the barbarian camps. ...
npc.tereban.wood_failure_2: [EN] It seems logical to search the most northern camp first, it is closest to the place where the tree was cut. Please hurry, there is still so much to do before the birthday.
npc.tereban.wood_no: [EN] The wood that I need should be in one of the barbarian camps. It seems logical to search the most northern camp first, it is closest to the place where the tree was cut. Please hurry, there is still so much to do before the birthday.
npc.tereban.wood_success: [EN] Thank you. I feel somewhat embarrassed to put you into such a danger for some birthday present but I am sure you can handle it.
npc.tereban_functions.multi_1: [EN] I have four sons which are very dear to me. Though they were born on the same day and even in the same hour, they took quite different paths in life. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_10: [EN] I met this troll when he was hanging around near the town. He carried something I would consider rather uncharacteristic for a troll: a stunningly beautiful cloak entirely made of white feathers. I was curious and asked him if he would sell it. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_11: [EN] He seemed to be more interested in some of my coins and a piece of meat than in this unusual garment. Therefore, we made a trade: He got some meat and coins and I got the cloak. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_12: [EN] I had a clue that it was a magical item but nobody in Edron knew something about it. As I have a very lettered friend in Darashia I took a magical carpet flight to visit him and ask him about the cloak. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_13: [EN] But then something very annoying happened: During the flight the wind blew so strongly that it tattered the cloak. Feather after feather was blown off the carpet but I didn't realise it. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_14: [EN] When I reached Darashia there was no cloak just a handful of feathers. *sighs* I'm not sure whether it makes sense to search for these feathers. There was a small wind gust when we were still above Edron. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_15: [EN] But the actual storm began when we were in the air above the Darama. The feathers are now scattered all over the desert I guess. Rather futile to look out for them but if you really want to try: ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_16: [EN] The magic carpet made a beeline from Edron to Darashia. You should search along this line on the ground. Good luck!
npc.tereban_functions.multi_2: [EN] Each of them chose a different vocation, one will become a knight, one a sorcerer, one a druid, and the other a paladin. In a few weeks they will reach adulthood and I am holding a birthday party for them. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_3: [EN] It should become a day to remember and so I want to give them something special as a present. I searched the land for the finest craftsmen so they could create suitable presents for my sons. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_4: [EN] But something of fine craftsmanship will just not cut it. So I asked them what they would need to create something special. They all came up with lists of rare and expensive items necessary for the task ahead. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_5: [EN] I spent a small fortune to buy most of the materials but in the end the key components are that rare that they cannot be simply bought somewhere. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_6: [EN] As far as I understood it, the places where you can get these items are quite dangerous and so it would take some adventurer to get them. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_7: [EN] That would be your mission if you are interested. Uhm, so are you interested?
npc.tereban_functions.multi_8: [EN] I'm so glad I finally have all the parts for the presents. Your reward is my eternal gratitude. Well, that and some gold of course. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_9: [EN] Take this sachet over there, I wrapped the coins into this old cape I had still lying around here from a barter with a stranger, it is of no use for me anyway. Farewell and thank you once again.
npc.tereban_functions.say_1: [EN] You are not on that mission.
npc.tereban_functions.say_2: [EN] Well, I need the parts of a sorcerer's robe, a paladin's bow, a knight's shield, and a druid's rod. If you cannot find one of them, ask me about it and I might provide you with some minor hints.
npc.tereban_functions.say_4: [EN] I am relieved someone as capable as you will handle the task. Well, I need the parts of a sorcerer's robe, a paladin's bow, a knight's shield, and a druid's wand.
npc.tereban_functions.say_5: [EN] Oh my. I really hope you will change your mind.
npc.terrence.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hey there, you are surely interested in helping the Rathleton city guard, right? Right - especially now since the dreaded minotaurs gain more ground every day.
npc.terrence.say_1: [EN] I'm not allowed to let just anyone pass. If you have proven your willingness and effort to participate in the fighting, I'm allowed to let you pass.
npc.terrence.say_3: [EN] You fought hard enough against the minotaurs. Since you've shown so much effort in our war, I'll let you pass through the gate.
npc.tesha.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.tesha.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.testserver_assistant.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hey {}. I'm Testserver Assistant and I can give {money}, {experience} and {blessing} which will be useful for testing on {} server. You can too to back to level 8 with {reset}.
npc.testserver_assistant.say_2: [EN] You can not take it anymore
npc.testserver_assistant.say_4: [EN] You have been blessed by all gods, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.testserver_assistant.say_5: [EN] You can not take it anymore
npc.thanita.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
npc.thanita.greet_msg_1: [EN] How could you sneak up on me like this? I thought you were one of THEM! Well, since you are not, what brings you to this wilderness?
npc.thanita.multi_1: [EN] Oh great! Supplies from Carlin! Let me see ...<she digs into the parcel>...ahh, nothing meaningful at all, like always. Well, before I give you the password for the delivery, you have to help me! ...
npc.thanita.multi_2: [EN] I have massive problems with the goblin tribe that lives here. You look strong enough to face their leader but you need to be smart to lure him out. ...
npc.thanita.multi_3: [EN] I heard they don't like fire very much, maybe that's worth a try. Their beds are mostly made of straw which is known as easily inflammable. ...
npc.thanita.multi_4: [EN] The entrance to their cave is at the pond south east of here.
npc.thanita.say_1: [EN] Impressive!! I could need someone like you here at the watchtower! Okay, the password you need to tell Bunny is ' password* '. Come back and visit me if you like to!
npc.thanita.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
npc.the_beggar_king.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hi! You look like someone on a {mission}.
npc.the_beggar_king.multi_1: [EN] Fine. But the first thing you have to know is that we are not the city's problem. We are just trying to survive. We usually seek shelter in the sewers.
npc.the_beggar_king.multi_2: [EN] There we are comparatively warm and safe. At least we were. But recently something has changed. There is {something} in the sewers. And it is hunting us.
npc.the_beggar_king.say_1: [EN] Some parts of the sewers were abandoned when they were beyond repair due to old age and earthquakes. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_2: [EN] That part was never truly well liked. There were rumours that the workers found some ancient structures there and that it was ripe with accidents during the construction. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_3: [EN] The city sealed those parts off, and I have no idea how anything could get in or out without the permission of the magistrate. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_4: [EN] But since you are investigating on their behalf, you might work out some agreement with them, if you're mad enough to enter the sewers at all. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_5: [EN] However, you will have to talk to one of the Glooth Brothers who are responsible for the sewer system's maintenance. You'll find them somewhere down there.
npc.the_beggar_king.say_6: [EN] Some parts of the sewers were abandoned when they were beyond repair due to old age and earthquakes. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_7: [EN] That part was never truly well liked. There were rumours that the workers found some ancient structures there and that it was ripe with accidents during the construction. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_8: [EN] The city sealed those parts off, and I have no idea how anything could get in or out without the permission of the magistrate. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_9: [EN] But since you are investigating on their behalf, you might work out some agreement with them, if you're mad enough to enter the sewers at all. ...
npc.the_blind_prophet.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted, friend of the apes.
npc.the_blind_prophet.say_13: [EN] You want me to transport you to forbidden land?
npc.the_blind_prophet.say_15: [EN] You are not worthy to be transported there yet.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_1: [EN] Me put name away name long ago. Now only blind prophet of ape people are.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_10: [EN] Our people a lot to learn have. One day we might live in peace with you hairless apes, who knows.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_11: [EN] Me not know. Me seldom have visions of not banana related objects.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_2: [EN] Me is who in dreams speak to holy banana. Me divine the will of banana.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_4: [EN] Me is who in dreams speak to holy banana. Me divine the will of banana.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_5: [EN] Me guard the forbidden land behind the great palisade. If any want to enter, he must ask me for transport.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_6: [EN] Me guard the forbidden land behind the great palisade. If any want to enter, he must ask me for transport.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_7: [EN] Good ape he is. Has to work hard to make other apes listen but you helped a lot.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_8: [EN]  Our holy ancestor he is. Big as mountain. Lizards say they built palisade to keep him but we not believe ... We think Bong palisade built to have peace from pesky lizards. We respect peace of Bong, keep people away from forbidden land.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_9: [EN]  The lizards evil and vengeful are. Ape people on guard must be.
npc.the_bone_master.multi_1: [EN] Welcome to the Brotherhood! From now on you will walk the path of Bones. A life full of promises and power has just beenoffered to you ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_2: [EN] Take it, if you are up to that challenge ... or perish in agony if you deserve this fate ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_3: [EN] You can always ask me about your current rank and about the privileges the ranks grant to those who hold them.
npc.the_bone_master.multi_4: [EN] But know that your decision will be irrevocable. You will abandon the opportunity to join any order whose doctrine is incontrast to our own ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_5: [EN] Do you still want to join the Brotherhood?
npc.the_bone_master.multi_6: [EN] The Brotherhood of Bones has suffered greatly in the past, but we did survive as we always will ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_7: [EN] You have proven resourceful by beating the silly riddles the Nightmare Knights set up to test their candidates ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_8: [EN] It's an amusing thought that after passing their test you might choose to join the ranks of their sworn enemies ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_9: [EN] For the irony of this I ask you, |PLAYERNAME|: Do you want to join the Brotherhood of Bones?
npc.the_bone_master.say_1: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Hyaena} rank? Did you bring 500 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_bone_master.say_2: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Death Dealer} rank? Did you bring 1000 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_bone_master.say_3: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Dread Lord} rank? Did you bring 1500 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_bone_master.say_4: [EN] You advanced to {Hyaena} rank! You are now able to use teleports of second floor of Knightwatch Tower.
npc.the_bone_master.say_5: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_bone_master.say_7: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_bone_master.say_8: [EN] You advanced to {Dread Lord} rank! You are now able to use teleports of fourth floor of Knightwatch Tower and to create addon scrolls.
npc.the_bone_master.say_9: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_dream_master.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye. May the gods watch over your path.
npc.the_dream_master.multi_1: [EN] So I welcome you as the latest member of the order of the Nightmare Knights. You entered this place as a stranger, butyou will leave this place as a friend ...
npc.the_dream_master.multi_2: [EN] You can always ask me about your current rank and about the privileges the ranks grant to those who hold them.
npc.the_dream_master.multi_3: [EN] The Nightmare Knights are almost extinct now, and as far as I know I am the only teacher that is left. But you might beright and its time to accept new disciples ...
npc.the_dream_master.multi_4: [EN] After all you have passed the Dream Challenge to reach this place, which used to be the process of initiation in the past...
npc.the_dream_master.multi_5: [EN] So I ask you: do you wish to become a member of the ancient order of the Nightmare Knights, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.the_dream_master.say_1: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Initiate} rank? Did you bring 500 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_dream_master.say_10: [EN] You advanced to {Lord Protector} rank! You are now able to use teleports of fourth floor of Knightwatch Tower and to create addon scrolls.
npc.the_dream_master.say_11: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_dream_master.say_2: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Dreamer} rank? Did you bring 1000 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_dream_master.say_3: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Lord Protector} rank? Did you bring 1500 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_dream_master.say_4: [EN] Please know that your decision is irrevocable. You will abandon the opportunity to join any order whose doctrine is incontrast to our own ...
npc.the_dream_master.say_5: [EN] Do you still want to join our order?
npc.the_dream_master.say_6: [EN] You advanced to {Initiate} rank! You are now able to use teleports of second floor of Knightwatch Tower.
npc.the_dream_master.say_7: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_dream_master.say_9: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_2: [EN] You succeeded! Issavi is safe again. Take this as a sign of our grace and gratitude, brave mortal being. It is a precious relic from earlier times. More precisely, it is one of four parts of the relic called the Regalia of Suon. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_3: [EN] Should you ever find the other three parts, a talented jeweler might be able to combine them and recreate the regalia for you.
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_4: [EN] I see. There is enough and adequate evidence that the Ambassador of Rathleton is indeed an arch traitor. So, Eshaya was right. Well done, mortal being. You have proven your loyalty and bravery, therefore allow me to ask you one more favour. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_5: [EN] The Cult of Fafnar is a serious problem for Issavi. The cultists are roaming the sewers and catacombs beneath the city now and again but this time they are really up to something. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_6: [EN] As a member of the Sapphire Blade found out, they are planning to cause a major earthquake, that could severely damage or even destroy Issavi. You may wonder how. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_7: [EN] Well, they want to activate five Fafnar statues which they have already enchanted. They are hidden in the catacombs underneath the city. Please go down and search for the statues. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_8: [EN] Then use this sceptre to bless them in the name of Suon and Bastesh. This will destroy the disastrous enchantment and Issavi will be safe again.
npc.the_first_dragon.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, my sparring buddy. We should have another fight sometimes. I think you may have earned a little reward.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_1: [EN] The definition of finer things is different for a dragon than for a human. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_10: [EN] Books are a wonderful {invention}. If you are ever tired of your heroic exploits, take the time to read one.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_11: [EN] The world has changed so much; I'm beginning to feel really old. People have changed, the face of the world has changed, even the laws of nature are no longer the same. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_12: [EN] I think it is the greatest advantage of you {humans} to be more flexible and adaptable.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_13: [EN] In hindsight I'm not too proud of this. This was some kind of juvenile bullying.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_14: [EN] In hindsight I'm not too proud of this. This was some kind of juvenile bullying.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_15: [EN] This led to certain vulnerabilities. However, the dragons overcame such shortcomings quickly and soon took their rightful place in the food chain, so to say.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_16: [EN] This led to certain vulnerabilities. However, the dragons overcame such shortcomings quickly and soon took their rightful place in the food chain, so to say.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_17: [EN] They used {weaknesses} to their advantage. It took some time before a dragon could be killed in a fair fight.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_18: [EN] They used {weaknesses} to their advantage. It took some time before a dragon could be killed in a fair fight.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_19: [EN] I really enjoy a good fight now and then. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_2: [EN] A young dragon appreciates diving into a lava pool, while an old dragon just can't stand to get rid of the {lava} afterwards and prefers bathing in boiling water.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_20: [EN] A real pain, however, is the constant annoyance caused by tedious fights against adventurers with more healing pots than brain.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_21: [EN] You are my greatest fans after all. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_22: [EN] If it becomes popular, I might consider an orcish translation or even one in bonelord language. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_23: [EN] By the way, it's a funny story how I learnt the bonelord language. However, I saved it for a possible part two of my memoirs.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_24: [EN] By the way, it's a funny story how I learnt the bonelord language. However, I saved it for a possible part two of my memoirs.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_25: [EN] Eventually there comes a time when you decide all the {hassle} isn't worth it anymore and you decide to concentrate on the {finer} things life has to offer.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_26: [EN] Eventually there comes a time when you decide all the {hassle} isn't worth it anymore and you decide to concentrate on the {finer} things life has to offer.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_27: [EN] Even in {retirement} I sometimes succumb to the temptation of sweet battle. Fighting was so different back in the old {times}. You can read about it in my {memoirs}. There should be a copy lying here somewhere.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_28: [EN] Have a look at the chests over there. Feel free to take the things you find within. You know, gold, gems and the like. There's also a garment I'm storing here for a while. As it doesn't fit me I have no need for it. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_29: [EN] But it might be a nice outfit for a little human. You also can take the porcelain mask and the feathers. There's a wizard named Muriel in Thais who reportedly embellishes outfits with stuff like this.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_3: [EN] Well, surely some of my kin might whine and complain as they always do. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_4: [EN] You have no idea how backwards thinking some dragons can be. A few are even still idealising the times before the {mists}.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_5: [EN] Being powerful creatures themselves, dragons had no need for inventions. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_6: [EN] However, now that times have changed and the pressure increases, even my kin might slowly start to change in order to {adapt}.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_7: [EN] Your books are an amazing thing. Draconic glyphs are so different. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_8: [EN] They are not only more complicated but also more specific. A single word which always keeps the same meaning is astonishingly effective in its primitive way. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_9: [EN] Books are a wonderful {invention}. If you are ever tired of your heroic exploits, take the time to read one.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_1: [EN] Times have changed <sigh>. In the past dragons were feared and respected. Only the {demons} rivalled our notoriety.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_2: [EN] Those upstarts! I wonder why would anyone care about them. They lack our style. For them it is all about brute force and showing-off.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_3: [EN] Breathing fire is an art! Instead of setting everything on fire, you exhale a cone of fire to give a worthy opponent a chance to avoid it.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_4: [EN] Your lives are so short and meaningless and yet you are here! And as a race you even have your own history and remember things with the help of {books}, which amazes me.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_5: [EN] I like the idea of books so much that I acquired a human servant to record my memoirs. You find a copy somewhere in my lair.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_6: [EN] Lava is only fun as long as it doesn't harden - then it turns into an annoyance.
npc.the_librarian.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, dear guest. If you are interested in paperware such as books or scrolls, ask me for a trade.
npc.the_librarian.multi_1: [EN] To extract memories from the ring, you have to enter a trance-like state with the help of a hallucinogen. Like this you can see all memories that are stored in the ring. Ask Faloriel for a respective potion. ...
npc.the_librarian.multi_2: [EN] Drink it while wearing the ring in the Temple of Bastesh and say: 'Sa Katesa Tarsani na'. If the legends are true you will be able to take memories with you in the form of memory shards.
npc.the_librarian.say_1: [EN] You don't need any instructions about the ring right now.
npc.the_librarian.voice_1: [EN] I really have to find this scroll. Where did I put it?
npc.the_librarian.voice_2: [EN] Too much dust here. I should tidy up on occasion.
npc.the_librarian.voice_3: [EN] Someone opened the Grimoire of Flames without permission. Egregious!
npc.the_lootmonger.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah, a customer! Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! I buy all kinds of loot, would you like a {trade}? I can also show you my {shop options}.
npc.the_lootmonger.say_2: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.the_oracle.farewell_msg_1: [EN] COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!
npc.the_oracle.greet_msg_1: [EN] {}, ARE YOU PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY?
npc.the_oracle.say_1: [EN] {}, I CAN'T LET YOU LEAVE - YOU ARE TOO STRONG ALREADY! \z YOU CAN ONLY LEAVE WITH LEVEL 9 OR LOWER.
npc.the_oracle.say_2: [EN] IN {}! AND WHAT PROFESSION HAVE YOU CHOSEN: \z {KNIGHT}, {PALADIN}, {SORCERER}, OR {DRUID}?
npc.the_oracle.say_3: [EN] IN WHICH TOWN DO YOU WANT TO LIVE: {CARLIN}, {THAIS}, OR {VENORE}?
npc.the_oracle.say_8: [EN] CHILD! COME BACK WHEN YOU HAVE GROWN UP!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_druid: [EN] A DRUID! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_knight: [EN] A KNIGHT! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_paladin: [EN] A PALADIN! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_sorcerer: [EN] A SORCERER! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!
npc.the_orc_king.greet_msg_1: [EN] Harrrrk! You think you are strong now? You shall never escape my wrath! I am immortal!
npc.the_orc_king.multi_1: [EN] I can sense your evil intentions to imprison a djinn! You are longing for the lamp, which I still possess. ...
npc.the_orc_king.multi_2: [EN] Who do you want to trap in this cursed lamp?
npc.the_orc_king.say_1: [EN] Arrrrgh! A dirty paleskin! To me my children! Kill them my guards!
npc.the_orc_king.say_2: [EN] For eons he was trapped in an enchanted lamp by some ancient race. Now he's free to roam the world again. Although he cheated me I appreciate what he and his brethren will do to this world, now it's the time of the Djinn again!
npc.the_orc_king.say_3: [EN] You bring me a stinking cookie???
npc.the_orc_king.say_4: [EN] I was waiting for this day! Take the lamp and let Malor feel my wrath!
npc.the_orc_king.say_5: [EN] I don't know your enemy, paleskin! Begone!
npc.the_orc_king.say_6: [EN] You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.the_orc_king.say_7: [EN] Well, I hope it stinks a lot. I like stinking cookies best ... BY MY THOUSAND SONS! YOU ARE SO DEAD HUMAN! DEAD!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_1: [EN] I am Charkahn the Slayer! The immortal father of the {orcs} and master of this {hive}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_10: [EN] Pah! Don't mock me, mortal! This shape is a curse which the evil {djinn} bestowed upon me!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_11: [EN] This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted {lamp}, and he {cheated} me!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_12: [EN] Because I freed him he granted me three wishes. He was true to his word in the first two {wishes}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_13: [EN] He built this fortress over Uldrek's grave within a single night. Also, he granted me my second wish and gave me immortality. Test it and try to kill me if you want. Har Har!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_14: [EN] I wished to father more healthy and fertile children as any orc has ever done. But the djinn cheated me and made me a slime! Then he laughed at me and left for his abandoned fortress in the {Deathwish} Mountains.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_15: [EN] His ancient fortress on Darama was deserted as the evil Djinn fled this world after his imprisonment. Now the time has come for the evil Djinns to return to their master although this will certainly awaken the {good Djinn} too.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_16: [EN] I will not share anything more about that topic with you {paleskins}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_17: [EN] You are as ugly as maggots, although not quite as as tasty.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_18: [EN] This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted lamp, and he cheated me!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_2: [EN] The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_3: [EN] The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_4: [EN] I can sense the presence and the feelings of my underlings and {minions}. I embrace the rage of the horde.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_5: [EN] The orcish horde of this hive is under my control. I sense their emotions and their needs and provide them with the leadership they need to focus their hate and rage
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_6: [EN] Hate and rage are the true blessings of Blog, since they are powerful weapons. They give the hive strength. I provide them with direction and focus.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_7: [EN] The Raging One blessed us with his burning hate. We are truly his children and therefore {divine}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_8: [EN] To conquer, to destroy and to dominate. Orcs are born to rule the {world}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_9: [EN] One day I will rule the world, even when turned into a {slime}.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.greet_msg_: [EN] Be greeted, dear visitor. Come and {stay} ... a while.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_1: [EN] If you have passed the first six seals and entered the blue fires that lead to the chamber of the seal you might receive my {kiss} ... It will open the last seal. Do you think you are ready?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_10: [EN] You have not found the hidden seal yet. Return when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_11: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: Oh yes, you have braved the plague seal. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_12: [EN] You have not faced the plagueseal yet. Return to me when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_13: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: Ah, I can sense the power of the seal of demonrage burning in your heart. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_14: [EN] You are not filled with the fury of the imprisoned demon. Return when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_15: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: So, you have managed to pass the seal of the true path. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_16: [EN] You have not found your true path yet. Return when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_17: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: I see! You have mastered the seal of logic. You have made the sacrifice, you have seen the unseen, you possess fortitude, you have filled yourself with power and found your path. You may ask me for my {kiss} now.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_18: [EN] You have not found your true path yet. Return to meh when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_2: [EN] Are you prepared to receive my kiss, even though this will mean that your death as well as a part of your soul will forever belong to me, my dear?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_20: [EN] You have spilled too much blood recently and the dead are hungry for your soul. Perhaps return when you regained you inner balance.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_21: [EN] Listen... there are no blooming flowers down here and the only smell present is that of death and decay. I wish that I could breathe the lovely smell of beautiful flowers just one more time, especially those which elves cultivate. Could you please bring me 50 holy orchids?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_22: [EN] Thank you. I will wait for your return.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_23: [EN] Thank you! You have no idea what that means to me. As promised, here is your reward... as a follower of Zathroth, I hope that you will like this accessory.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_25: [EN] Then try to be better prepared next time we meet.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_26: [EN] Perhaps it is the better choice for you, my dear.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_3: [EN] You have already received my kiss. You should know better then to ask for it.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_4: [EN] Your wish for a spectral dress is silly. Although I will grant you the permission to take one. My maidens left one in a box in a room, directly south of here.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_5: [EN] Say... I have been longing for something for an eternity now... if you help me retrieve it, I will reward you. Do you consent to this arrangement?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_6: [EN] Have you really brought me 50 holy orchids?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_7: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: Yessss, I can sense you have passed the seal of sacrifice. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_8: [EN] You have not passed the seal of sacrifice yet. Return to me when you are better prepared.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.say_9: [EN] The Queen of the Banshee: I sense you have passed the hidden seal as well. Have you passed any other seal yet?
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_2: [EN] It's my curse to be the eternal {guardian} of this ancient {place}.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_3: [EN] I'm the {guardian} of the {SEVENTH} and final seal. The seal to open the last door before ... but perhaps it's better to see it with your own eyes.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_4: [EN] It served as a temple, a source of power and ... as a sender for an ancient {race} which lived a long time ago and has long been forgotten.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_5: [EN] The race that built this edifice came to this place from the stars. They ran from an enemy even more horrible than themselves. But they carried the {seed} of their own destruction in them.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_6: [EN] This ancient race was annihilated by its own doings, that's all I know. Aeons have passed since then, but the sheer presence of this {complex} is still defiling and desecrating this area.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_7: [EN] Its constructors were too strange for you or even me to understand. We don't know what this ... thing they built was supposed to be good for. I feel a constant twisting and binding of souls, though, that is probably only a side-effect.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_8: [EN] The place you know as the Ghostlands had a different name once ... and many names after. Too many to remember them all.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.walkaway_m: [EN] Yes, flee from death. But know it shall be always one step behind you.
npc.theodore_loveless.multi_1: [EN] Ah what a fine blend. I really ...
npc.theodore_loveless.multi_2: [EN] OUCH! What have you done you fool? How dare you???
npc.theodore_loveless.say_1: [EN] Oh my. Have you gotten an exquisite cigar for me, my young friend?
npc.theodore_loveless.say_2: [EN] Oh, then there must be a misunderstanding.
npc.thorgrin.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage} back, I can help you.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_1:
[EN] In this category I have '{Bruise Bane}', '{Cure Bleeding}', '{Wound Cleansing}', \z
		'{Cure Poison}', '{Intense Wound Cleansing}', '{Recovery}' and '{Intense Recovery}'.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_2:
[EN] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Haste}', \z
		'{Charge}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_3:
[EN] I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn? \z
		You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_4: [EN] In this category I have '{Whirlwind Throw}', '{Groundshaker}', '{Berserk}' and '{Fierce Berserk}' as well as ... '{Brutal Strike}', '{Front Sweep}', '{Inflict Wound}' and '{Annihilation}'.
npc.tibra.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. May the gods be with you to guard and guide you, my child!
npc.tibra.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.tibra.stdmod_1: [EN] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, my child.
npc.tibra.stdmod_10: [EN] I am a priest of the great pantheon.
npc.tibra.stdmod_11: [EN] The teachings of Crunor tell us to honor life and not to harm it.
npc.tibra.stdmod_12: [EN] It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.
npc.tibra.stdmod_13: [EN] It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.
npc.tibra.stdmod_14: [EN] My name is Tibra. Your soul tells me that you are |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.tibra.stdmod_15: [EN] Queen Eloise is wise to listen to the proposals of the druidic followers of Crunor.
npc.tibra.stdmod_16: [EN] The grace of the gods must be earned, it cannot be bought!
npc.tibra.stdmod_17: [EN] The world of Tibia is the creation of the gods.
npc.tibra.stdmod_19: [EN] There's something strange in its neighbourhood. But whom we gonna call for help if not the gods?
npc.tibra.stdmod_2: [EN] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.tibra.stdmod_20: [EN] Remind: Not everything you call monster is evil to the core!
npc.tibra.stdmod_21: [EN] The mythical blade was hidden in ancient times. Its said that powerful wards protect it.
npc.tibra.stdmod_22: [EN] The fallen one should be mourned, not feared.
npc.tibra.stdmod_23: [EN] Only a man can fall as low as he did. His soul rotted away already.
npc.tibra.stdmod_24: [EN] The gods of good guard us and guide us, the gods of evil want to destroy us and steal our souls!
npc.tibra.stdmod_25: [EN] The gods we call the good ones are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
npc.tibra.stdmod_26: [EN] Fardos is the creator. The great obsever. He is our caretaker.
npc.tibra.stdmod_27: [EN] Uman is the positive aspect of magic. He brings us the secrets of the arcane arts.
npc.tibra.stdmod_28: [EN] Air is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
npc.tibra.stdmod_29: [EN] Fire is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
npc.tibra.stdmod_3: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Hope may fill your heart - doubt shall be banned'. Now, bring your stake to Maealil in the elven settlement for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.tibra.stdmod_30: [EN] Sula is the essence of the elemental power of water.
npc.tibra.stdmod_31: [EN] Suon is the lifebringing sun. He observes the creation with love.
npc.tibra.stdmod_32: [EN] Crunor, the great tree, is the father of all plantlife. He is a prominent god for many druids.
npc.tibra.stdmod_33: [EN] Nornur is the mysterious god of fate. Who knows if he is its creator or just a chronist?
npc.tibra.stdmod_34: [EN] Bastesh, the deep one, is the goddess of the sea and its creatures.
npc.tibra.stdmod_35: [EN] Kirok, the mad one, is the god of scientists and jesters.
npc.tibra.stdmod_36: [EN] Toth, Lord of Death, is the keeper of the souls, the guardian of the afterlife.
npc.tibra.stdmod_37: [EN] Banor, the heavenly warrior, is the patron of all fighters against evil. He is the gift of the gods to inspire humanity.
npc.tibra.stdmod_38: [EN] The gods we call the evil ones are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons!
npc.tibra.stdmod_39: [EN] Zathroth is the destructive aspect of magic. He is the deciver and the thief of souls.
npc.tibra.stdmod_40: [EN] Fafnar is the scorching sun. She observes the creation with hate and jealousy.
npc.tibra.stdmod_41: [EN] Brog, the raging one, is the great destroyer. The berserk of darkness.
npc.tibra.stdmod_42: [EN] The bonemaster Urgith is the lord of the undead and keeper of the damned souls.
npc.tibra.stdmod_43: [EN] The demons are followers of Zathroth. The cruelest are known as the ruthless seven.
npc.tibra.stdmod_44: [EN] I don't want to talk about that subject!
npc.tibra.stdmod_5: [EN] You should visit Maealil in the elven settlement now, my child.
npc.tibra.stdmod_6: [EN] You already received my line of the prayer, dear child.
npc.tibra.stdmod_7: [EN] A blessed stake? That is a strange request, my child. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.tibra.stdmod_8: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.tibra.stdmod_9: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.tigo.greet_msg_1: [EN] There, there initiate. You will now become one of us, as so many before you. One of the {Barkless}. Walk with us and you will walk tall my friend.
npc.tigo.multi_1: [EN] The trial consists of three steps. The trial of tar, where you will suffer unbearable heat and embrace the stigma of misfortune. ...
npc.tigo.multi_2: [EN] To purge your soul, your body will have to be near absolute zero, the point where life becomes impossible. ...
npc.tigo.multi_3: [EN] Something about you is different.  I know that you will find a way to return even if you should die during the purification. And if you do... Leiden will become aware of you and retreat. ...
npc.tigo.multi_4: [EN] If he does, follow him into his own chambers. Barkless are neither allowed to go near the throne room, aside from being judged, nor can we actually enter it.
npc.tigo.multi_5: [EN] He should be easy to defeat with his back to the wall, find him - and delvier us from whatever became of the Penitent.
npc.tigo.multi_6: [EN] He should be easy to defeat with his back to the wall, find him - and delvier us from whatever became of the Penitent.
npc.tigo.say_1: [EN] You are now one of us. Learn to endure this world's suffering in every facet and take delight in the soothing eternity that waits for the {purest} of us on the other side.
npc.tigo.say_2: [EN] Purification is but one of the difficult steps on your way to the other side. The {trial} of tar, sulphur and ice.
npc.tim_the_guard.multi_1: [EN] It's not a drama!! I think there is just no god who's responsible for toothbrush safety, that's all ...
npc.tim_the_guard.multi_2: [EN] And even IF through some miracle the stupid toothbrush had jumped out of the toilet into my hand, I honestly doubt I would ever use it again.
npc.tim_the_guard.say_1: [EN] Ah, well. Just this morning my new toothbrush fell into the toilet.
npc.tim_the_guard.say_2: [EN] What do you mean? Of course they will immediately send someone with extra long and thin arms to retrieve it!
npc.tim_the_guard.say_3: [EN] Your humour might let end you up beaten in some dark alley, you know? No, I don't think someone could have prevented that accident!
npc.tim_the_guard.stdmod_1: [EN] It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.timothy.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, hello! It's a pleasure to see a visitor from the continent.
npc.timothy.multi_1: [EN] Oh, you are the contact person of the academy? Here are the notes that contain everything I have found out so far. ...
npc.timothy.multi_2: [EN] This city is absolutely fascinating, I tell you! If there hadn't been all this trouble and chaos in the past, this city would certainly be the greatest centre of knowledge in the world. ...
npc.timothy.multi_3: [EN] Oh, by the way, speaking about all the trouble here reminds me of Palimuth, a friend of mine. He is a native who was quite helpful in gathering all these information. ...
npc.timothy.multi_4: [EN] I'd like to pay him back for his kindness by sending him some experienced helper that assists him in his effort to restore some order in this city. Maybe you are interested in this job?
npc.timothy.say_1: [EN] Excellent! You will find Palimuth near the entrance of the city centre. Just ask him if you can assist him in a few missions.
npc.timur.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to my little shop, adventurer! First read my blackboards.
npc.timur.voice_2: [EN] Selling ammunition and buying bows and crossbows!
npc.todd.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Yes, goodbye |PLAYERNAME|, just leave me alone.
npc.todd.greet_msg_1: [EN] Uhm oh hello |PLAYERNAME|... not so loud please... my {head}... What ... do you {want}?
npc.todd.multi_1: [EN] I'd really like to rebuild my reputation someday and maybe find a nice girl. If you come across scrolls of heroic deeds or addresses of lovely maidens... let me know! ...
npc.todd.multi_2: [EN] Oh no, it doesn't matter what name is on the scrolls. I'm, uhm... flexible! And money - yes, I can pay. My, erm... uncle died recently and left me a pretty sum. Yes.
npc.todd.stdmod_1: [EN] I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
npc.todd.stdmod_10: [EN] I don't know anything about money, missing or not.
npc.todd.stdmod_11: [EN] He often comes here. But his constant confusion gives me a worse headache than Frodo's beer. I rather avoid him.
npc.todd.stdmod_12: [EN] Uhm, never heard about him... and you can't prove otherwise.
npc.todd.stdmod_13: [EN] Thats a common name, perhaps I met a William, not sure about that.
npc.todd.stdmod_2: [EN] I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
npc.todd.stdmod_3: [EN] Uhhh ohhhh one of the beers yesterday must have been bad.
npc.todd.stdmod_4: [EN] My Name? I am To... ahm... hum... My name is {Hugo}.
npc.todd.stdmod_5: [EN] Yes, that's my name of course.
npc.todd.stdmod_6: [EN] Uh .. I... I met a Todd on the road. He told me he was traveling to Venore, look there for your Todd.
npc.todd.stdmod_8: [EN] I never was there. Now leave me alone.
npc.todd.stdmod_9: [EN] Resistance is futile... uhm... I wonder where I picked that saying up. Oh my head...
npc.tom.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|. Did Vascalir send you to me for a {mission}?
npc.tom.greet_msg_2: [EN] Now, now - we can't work with that. Go back to that wolf den and fulfil your mission! Unless there is anything else I can help you with.
npc.tom.greet_msg_3: [EN] Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|. You look... exhausted. Did you run a lot? And more importantly, were you able to find some war wolf leather?
npc.tom.say_37: [EN] I had some cough syrup a while ago. It was stolen in an ape raid. I fear if you want more cough syrup you will have to buy it in the druids guild in carlin.
npc.tom.say_38: [EN] Would you like to wear bear paws like I do? No problem, just bring me 50 bear paws and 50 wolf paws and I'll fit them on.
npc.tom.say_39: [EN] Have you brought 50 bear paws and 50 wolf paws?
npc.tom.say_40: [EN] Excellent! Like promised, here are your bear paws.
npc.tom.stdmod_1: [EN] Buying fresh corpses of rats, rabbits and wolves.
npc.tom.stdmod_10: [EN] {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle} sell my leather clothes in their shops.
npc.tom.stdmod_11: [EN] That's my job. It can be dirty at times but it provides enough income for my living.
npc.tom.stdmod_12: [EN] Do I look like a tourist information centre? Go ask someone else.
npc.tom.stdmod_13: [EN] Help? I will give you a few gold coins if you have some fresh dead {animals} for me. Note the word {fresh}.
npc.tom.stdmod_14: [EN] Fresh means: shortly after their death.
npc.tom.stdmod_16: [EN] Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.tom.stdmod_17: [EN] Dungeons can be dangerous without proper {equipment}.
npc.tom.stdmod_18: [EN] You need at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.tom.stdmod_19: [EN] Sorry, I haven't been outside for a while, so I don't know.
npc.tom.stdmod_2: [EN] Oh yeah, I'm also interested in wolf paws and bear paws.
npc.tom.stdmod_20: [EN] Troll leather stinks. Can't use it.
npc.tom.stdmod_21: [EN] I don't buy orcs. Their skin is too scratchy.
npc.tom.stdmod_23: [EN] Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Go see {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.tom.stdmod_24: [EN] Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Ask {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.tom.stdmod_25: [EN] Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.tom.stdmod_26: [EN] I'm buying fresh {corpses} of rats, rabbits and wolves. I don't buy half-decayed ones. If you have any for sale, {trade} with me.
npc.tom.stdmod_29: [EN] He's a better cook than his cousin {Willie}, actually.
npc.tom.stdmod_30: [EN] I kinda like him. At least he says what he thinks.
npc.tom.stdmod_32: [EN] He sticks his nose too much in books.
npc.tom.stdmod_33: [EN] My mother?? Did you meet my mother??
npc.tom.stdmod_34: [EN] I don't have a problem with him.
npc.tom.stdmod_36: [EN] It's in the academy, just above Seymour. Go there once you are level 8 to leave this place.
npc.tom.stdmod_4: [EN] Alright. Can I help you with something else then?
npc.tom.stdmod_45:
[EN] I can help you get boots, but I can't give them to you for free. Besides, you'd want good boots, not that stuff made from rat leather. The best leather you'd find on Rook is wolf leather. ... \z
	War wolf leather, to be precise. Problem is - war wolves are rare, and you can't hope to fight and defeat them. So your only chance is to find an already dead war wolf, take his skin, and escape really fast. ... \z
	What an interesting coincidence that I've seen a poacher sneak into the wolf den just a few hours ago. I'm not exactly a fan of poachers - they kill too many of our wolves. ... \z
	Sooo... what I'm suggesting is: follow his traces into the wolf den, and if you get lucky, you'll be able to take one of his illegally obtained war wolf skins. ... \z
	That's why I wouldn't call it 'stealing', what an ugly word... anyway, if you bring the skin back to me, I'll make some great war wolf boots from them. What do you say?
npc.tom.stdmod_46:
[EN] Hmm... unfortunately the skin is damaged too badly. Whoever skinned this wolf wasn't very skilled at it. Hmm. ... \z
	Ah, no need to fret. Tell you what kid, I'm gonna give you some normal leather boots instead. They should keep your feet warm as well. Here you go. ... \z
	By the way... that running you did to get out of the cave will be your normal walking speed when you are several levels higher. With each level you gain, you'll also become a little faster. ... \z
	There are also other items, spells and equipment that increase your speed. ... \z
	You can also tame creatures to ride on that will also increase your speed. So don't worry if you're out of breath now - you won't always be that slow. Now off with you and back to Vascalir, I have work to do.
npc.tom.stdmod_5: [EN] That's what I thought. I marked the wolf den on your map. To go there, exit the village to the north and walk north-east. Good luck finding that poacher and figuring out a plan to take those skins! Hehe.
npc.tom.stdmod_6: [EN] Well, then walk Rookgaard barefoot. It's up to you!
npc.tom.stdmod_7: [EN] Are you sure? I think I see some war wolf leather on you. You should reply with {yes}.
npc.tom.stdmod_8: [EN] My name is Tom the tanner.
npc.tom.stdmod_9: [EN] I'm the local {tanner}. I buy fresh animal {corpses}, tan them, and convert them into fine leather clothes which I then sell to {merchants}.
npc.tom.voice_1: [EN] Buying fresh corpses of rats, rabbits and wolves.
npc.tom.voice_2: [EN] Oh yeah, I'm also interested in wolf paws and bear paws.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello hello! Always good to see fresh blood! What brings you here?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_1: [EN] Sanguine! Did you see those sparks! We definitely had some energy transfer! Well done! Now, for your reward. ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_10: [EN] The second sample you must retrieve from the sacrificial chamber in the ancient vampire crypts, first floor, far west. ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_11: [EN] Take these two sterilised vials, one for each blood basin. Oh, I wish I could go myself! Come back when you have filled both vials.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_12: [EN] So someone sent you after a scroll, eh? A stroll for a scroll! <chuckles> Sounds like an old-fashioned necromancer thing. ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_13: [EN] Well, this piece here is a rather fascinating thing - see those strange blood stains? - ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_14: [EN] My predecessors have had it for quite a while without finding out more - I was hoping to investigate, but there's always so much to do! ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_15: [EN] Ah, so you want it, too? Well, do me a favour: fetch two samples and assist in my experiment, in exchange for the scroll piece. Yes?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_2: [EN] Err... I would awfully like to know more about the scroll ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_3: [EN] Would you settle for a heartfelt handshake instead - oh, you wouldn't? Well, er, okay ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_4: [EN] Give me a minute or two to retrieve it. Ask me for the {scroll} or the {mission}
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_5: [EN] Now, let me see... yes... yes... very good. Let me add THIS ..... swill it... there. Sanguine! ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_6: [EN] We're not finished yet. Take this tainted blood vial ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_7: [EN] Dab some drops from it on to the four blood pagodas in the inner circle here. Then pull the lightning lever over there.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_8: [EN] Sanguine! I need two different blood samples - The first one from the necromancer's pure blood chamber. ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.multi_9: [EN] I was barred from the premises. For my research! Shameful! I'm a martyr to the cause - oh, the second sample you said? ...
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.say_1: [EN] Hello hello! Did you bring those blood samples?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.say_3: [EN] Hello hello! Did Hello hello! Well now, painted all those blood pagodas properly?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.say_4: [EN] Hello hell- oh, you've come for the scroll, haven't you?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.say_5: [EN] My heart bleeds to part from it. Here. Extend your hand - I'll just retrieve some blood from in exchange - HOLD STILL.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.voice_1: [EN] Interesting reaction. Bloodcurdling. Must inspect further.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.voice_3: [EN] Hmm... the conductors are too dry to transmit energy.

npc.tonar.voice_1: [EN] What a beautiful day for a little boat trip.

npc.tonar_oskayaat.voice_1: [EN] I don't feel safe here ... I hope we can return to Ankrahmun soon.

npc.topsy.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, dear |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you? \z If you need magical equipment such as {runes} or {wands}, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.topsy.say_1: [EN] So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
