npc.xorlosh.greet_msg_1: [EN] Who are you? Are you a genius in mechanics? You don't look like one.
npc.xorlosh.multi_1: [EN] There should be a book in our library about tunnelling. I don't have that much time to talk to you about that. ...
npc.xorlosh.multi_2: [EN] If you want to have some information, you'll just have to find that book. If you need some equipment, go ask Harog. You'll find the library in the north eastern wing of Beregar city.
npc.xorlosh.say_1: [EN] Hmmmm, you could indeed help me. See this mechanism? Some son of a rotworm put WAY too much stuff on this elevator and now it's broken. I need 3 gear wheels to fix it. You think you could get them for me?
npc.xorlosh.say_2: [EN] HOLY MOTHER OF ALL ROTWORMS! You did it and they are of even better quality than the old ones. You should be the first one to try the elevator, just jump on it. See you my friend.
npc.xorlosh.say_3: [EN] That would be great! Maybe a blacksmith can forge you some. Come back when you got them and ask me about your mission.
npc.xorlosh.say_4: [EN] The book about tunnelling is in the library which is located in the north eastern wing of Beregar city.
npc.yalahari.multi_1: [EN] Hm, no sign of any notes you say? That's odd - odd and a bit suspicious. I doubt you have tried hard enough. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_10: [EN] We need you to enter one of the lesser damaged factories. Go to the factory district and look for a pattern crystal used for weapon production. Use it on the factory controller. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_11: [EN] It will ensure that the factory will provide us with a suitable amount of weapons which we dearly need to reclaim and secure the most dangerous parts of the city. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_12: [EN] I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the factory quarter now. Just use the gate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_13: [EN] Recently, our fishermen have been attacked by a maritime race called the quara. They live in the sunken quarter and are a significant threat to our people. I ask you to enter the sunken quarter and slay all their leaders. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_14: [EN] We believe that there are three leaders in this area. Your task is simple enough, so you better don't fail! ...
npc.yalahari.multi_15: [EN] I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the sunken quarter now. Just use the gate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_16: [EN] Ah, what an unexpected sight. I can almost feel the energy of the charm. It will help to recover some of the past wealth. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_17: [EN] You did quite an impressive job. I'm considering to introduce you to my ma.. to my direct superior one day. But there are still other missions to fulfil.
npc.yalahari.multi_18: [EN] Destroyed you say? That's impossible! I'm not sure if I can trust you in this matter? One might assume, you fled from the ghosts in terror and left the charm there. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_19: [EN] You will have to work twice as hard on your next missions to restore the trust you have lost.
npc.yalahari.multi_2: [EN] There are only a few chances to impress us. For those who please us great rewards are in store. If you fail though, you might lose more than you can imagine.
npc.yalahari.multi_20: [EN] The old cemetery of the city has been abandoned decades ago when the activity of the various undead there became unbearable. The reason for their appearance was never found out or researched. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_21: [EN] However, those undead could be useful, at least some of them. Particular ghosts consist of a substance that is very similar to the energy source that powered some of our devices. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_22: [EN] Since we lack most of the original sources, some substitute might come in handy. Take this ghost charm and place it on the strange carving in the cemetery. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_23: [EN] Use it to attract ghosts and slay them. Then use the residues of the ghosts on the charm to capture the essence. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_24: [EN] Once it is filled, ghosts will not be attracted any longer. Then return the charm to me. I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the cemetery quarter now. Just use the gate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_25: [EN] So have you won us a new ally? Excellent. I knew you would not dare to ruin this mission. Soon we might be able to strengthen our defences and even relocate some of our guards. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_26: [EN] Perhaps some day soon, you lead your own unit of men. However, there are more missions that need to be accomplished. Let's talk about them.
npc.yalahari.multi_27: [EN] This druid dares to affront us? We will look into this when we have enough time. But there are other things that needs to be settled. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_28: [EN] Although, we probably should not do so after your last failure, we are willing to grant you another mission.
npc.yalahari.multi_29: [EN] As you probably noticed, once our city had a park and a zoo around a grand arena. It was a favourite pastime of our citizens to visit this quarter in their spare time. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_3: [EN] For your noble deeds, we would like to invite you to a special celebration ceremony. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_30: [EN] Nowadays, the quarter is lost. The animals are on the loose, and an attempt to revitalise the city with new arena games resulted in a revolt of the foreign gladiators. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_31: [EN] Now all kinds of beasts roam the park, and gladiators challenge them and visitors to test their skills. One of the residents is an ancient druid that rather cares foranimals than for people. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_32: [EN] It is said that he is able to use magic to breed animals with changed abilities and appearances. Such skills are of course quite useful for us. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_33: [EN] We lack the manpower to retake all quarters, or just to defend ourselves adequately. If he bred us some guards and warbeasts, we could strengthen our positionconsiderably. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_34: [EN] Travel to the arena quarter and gain his assistance for us. I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the arena quarter now. Just use thegate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_35: [EN] I hope you gave this criminal a real scare! I'm sure he'll remember what he has to expect if he arouses our anger again. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_36: [EN] You have proven yourself as quite valuable with this mission! That was just the first step on your rise through the ranks of our helpers. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_37: [EN] Just ask me for more missions and we will see what you are capable of!
npc.yalahari.multi_38: [EN] So he has been too uncooperative for you? Well, you weren't the first we have sent and you won't be the last. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_39: [EN] However, if you cannot even serve us as a bully, we might have to rethink if you are the right person for us. That was a bad job and we don't tolerate many of them.
npc.yalahari.multi_4: [EN] Only the most prominent Yalahari are allowed to join the festivities. I assume you can imagine what honour it is that you'vebeen invited to join us. Meet us in the inner city's centre. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_40: [EN] We surely cannot allow some underworld kingpin to rule a significant part of the city. Although, I have to admit that his firm grip on the former trade quarter might be useful....
npc.yalahari.multi_41: [EN] I expect you to fight your way through his minions and to show him that we are determined and powerful enough to retake the quarter, if necessary by force. Talk to himafter killing some of his henchmen. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_42: [EN] I'm sure he'll understand that he will succumb to a greater power. That's how his little empire has worked after all. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_43: [EN] Also, I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the trade quarter now. Just use the gate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_44: [EN] The former alchemist quarter was struck by even more disasters than the rest of the city. Fires, explosions, poisonous fumes - all sorts of catastrophes. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_45: [EN] The worst plague, however, are unknown diseases that have spread in this quarter and eradicated any human population. We must stop it before other quarters areafflicted. We already identified certain carriers responsible for spreading the plague. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_46: [EN] It will be your task to eliminate them. This spell will protect you from becoming infected yourself. Enter the alchemist quarter and kill the three plague carriers, and atbest anything else you might find there. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_47: [EN] Even more important, retrieve the last research notes that the local alchemists made before the plague killed them. They might be the key for a cure or something else. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_48: [EN] At least we have to make sure that these scientists did not die in vain, and honour their researches. So please bring us these research notes. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_49: [EN] Also, I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the alchemist quarter. Just use the gate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_5: [EN] As our most trusted ally, you may pass all doors to reach the festivity hall. There you will receive your reward for the achievements you have gained so far. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_50: [EN] If you please us, a life of luxury as an important person in our city is ensured. If you fail, you will be replaced by someone more capable than you. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_51: [EN] So if you are up for a challenge, ask me for a {mission}.
npc.yalahari.multi_52: [EN] So if you are up for a challenge, ask me for a {mission}.
npc.yalahari.multi_53: [EN] With all the coming and going of strangers here, it would be quite tedious to explain everything again and again. So we have written a manifesto. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_54: [EN] Grab a copy from the room behind me. Let's talk about your further career in our ranks once you've read it.
npc.yalahari.multi_6: [EN] I'm convinced your reward will be beyond your wildest dreams. And that is just the beginning!
npc.yalahari.multi_7: [EN] I'm impressed by your support for our cause. Still, I'm aware that this scheming Palimuth tried to influence you. Think about who are your real friends and who can assist you in your career. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_8: [EN] Come back if you have decided to which side you want to belong.
npc.yalahari.multi_9: [EN] In the past, we had many magical factories providing the citizens with everything they needed. Now that most of these factories are shut down, we have trouble getting enough supplies. ...
npc.yalahari.say_1: [EN] So you have killed the plague carriers. Have you also retrieved the research papers?
npc.yalahari.say_2: [EN] This will teach these fishmen who is the ruler of that area. You have earned yourself a special privilege. But we will talk about that when we speak about your next mission.
npc.yalahari.say_3: [EN] Your failure is an outrage! I think we have to talk about the missions you have accomplished so far.
npc.yalahari.say_4: [EN] Now we will have power we truly deserve!...
npc.yalahari.say_5: [EN] So do you want to side with me |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.yalahari.say_6: [EN] Great work, take this outfit and you are able to open the door to the reward room.
npc.yalahari.say_7: [EN] Impressive indeed! Someone with your skills will quickly raise in our ranks of helpers. You have great potential, and if you are upfor further missions, just ask for them.
npc.yalahari.say_8: [EN] I knew that you were smart enough to make the right decision! Your next mission will be a special one!
npc.yaman.multi_2: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.yaman.say_1: [EN] Shove off, little one! Humans are not welcome here, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.yaman.say_10: [EN] Sorry but you don't have the item.
npc.yaman.say_11: [EN] You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.yaman.say_12: [EN] You see, good deeds like this will ... YOU ... YOU SPAWN OF EVIL! I WILL MAKE SURE THE MASTER LEARNS ABOUT THIS!
npc.yaman.say_15: [EN] I'm sorry, but you don't have Malor's permission to trade with me.
npc.yaman.say_2: [EN] Be greeted, human |PLAYERNAME|. How can a humble djinn be of service?
npc.yaman.say_3: [EN] Do you want to trade Boots of haste for Enchanted Chicken Wing?
npc.yaman.say_4: [EN] Do you want to trade 4 Warrior Helmet for Warrior Sweat?
npc.yaman.say_5: [EN] Do you want to trade 2 Royal Helmet for Fighting Spirit
npc.yaman.say_6: [EN] Do you want to trade 3 Fire Sword for Magic Sulphur
npc.yaman.say_7: [EN] I trade Enchanted Chicken Wing for Boots of Haste, Warrior Sweat for 4 Warrior Helmets, Fighting Spirit for 2 Royal Helmet Magic Sulphur for 3 Fire Swords
npc.yaman.say_8: [EN] You brought cookies! How nice of you! Can I have one?
npc.yaman.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] At your service, just browse through my wares.

npc.yberius.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.yberius.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.yberius.stdmod_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.yberius.stdmod_11: [EN] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake.
npc.yberius.stdmod_12: [EN] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.yberius.stdmod_13: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Protection will be granted - from dangers at hand'. Now, bring your stake to Isimov in the dwarven settlement for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.yberius.stdmod_15: [EN] You should visit Isimov in the dwarven settlement now.
npc.yberius.stdmod_16: [EN] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.yberius.stdmod_17: [EN] A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.yberius.stdmod_18: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.yberius.stdmod_19: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.yberius.stdmod_2: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.yberius.stdmod_20: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.yberius.stdmod_21: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.yberius.stdmod_22: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.yberius.stdmod_23: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.yberius.stdmod_24: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.yberius.stdmod_25: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.yberius.stdmod_26: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.yberius.stdmod_27: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.yberius.stdmod_28: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.yberius.stdmod_29: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.yberius.stdmod_30: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.yberius.stdmod_32:

npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_12: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_13: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_14: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_15: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_16: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_17: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_18: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_19: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_2: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_20: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_21: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_22: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_23: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_25:
[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_4: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_7: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_9: [EN] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.zerbrus.greet_1: [EN] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.zerbrus.greet_2: [EN] <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_1: [EN] Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_11: [EN] I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_12: [EN] My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_13: [EN] Before you fight monsters, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_15: [EN] I have to stay here, sorry. But I can {heal} you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_16: [EN] I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_17: [EN] I'm not a gossiper, but if you want to know something about a certain Rookgaardian, ask.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_18: [EN] They're not that dangerous, but don't let yourself get cornered by many of them. They still can hurt.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_19: [EN] There are two types of spiders on this island: normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_20: [EN] Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_21: [EN] You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_22: [EN] The orcs have a hideout under the troll cave, just descend deep. Still, be very careful!
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_23: [EN] Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_24: [EN] They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner monsters.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_25: [EN] The skeletons on this island are usually fairly hidden. They are often found near graves and always underground. Beware of their evil life drain.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_26: [EN] There is a bear cave close to this bridge. Be careful, though, they hit hard!
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_27: [EN] Wasp hives exist only behind the north bridge, so ask {Dallheim} for information. I'm glad there are no wasps here. They always make me jump.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_28: [EN] Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_29: [EN] Premium warriors pay. They gain many advantages this way.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_3: [EN] No monster shall go past me.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_32: [EN] A place of protection. Nothing can harm you there.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_33: [EN] I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_34: [EN] The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_35: [EN] There are {wolves}, {bears}, {snakes}, {deer}, and {spiders} in the wilderness past this bridge.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_37: [EN] The heavenly warrior! Read {books} to learn about him.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_38: [EN] You will learn about magic soon enough.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_39: [EN] In the world of Tibia, many challenges await the brave adventurer.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_4: [EN] The premium side of Rookgaard lies beyond.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_40: [EN] There are many books in the {academy}. Theory can be just as important as practice.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_41: [EN] It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_42: [EN] It looks like you have mastered the drill.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_43: [EN] Sorry, I don't trade. Ask the shop owners for a trade instead.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_44: [EN] I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are not especially helpful in improving the situation.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_46: [EN] He sells {weapons}. His shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_47: [EN] He dedicated his life to welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_49: [EN] There's something about this guy I don't like.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_5: [EN] Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_50: [EN] She's very attractive. Too bad my duty leaves me no time to date her.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_51: [EN] He guards the temple and can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned, just like me.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_52: [EN] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_54: [EN] Her shop is just north of the bridge. She really has good offers.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_55: [EN] Gentle girl, but a little to esoteric for my taste. However, her {potions} might come in handy.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_56: [EN] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_58: [EN] His job of teaching young heroes is important for the survival of all of us.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_6: [EN] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_7: [EN] <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_9: [EN] Hmm, |PLAYERNAME|. I really don't know if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.
npc.zerbrus.voice_1: [EN] Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.zerbrus.voice_3: [EN] No monster shall go past me.
npc.zerbrus.voice_4: [EN] The premium side of Rookgaard lies beyond.
npc.zerbrus.voice_5: [EN] Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.zethra.voice_1: [EN] Come over here if you have to resupply!
npc.zirella.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye |PLAYERNAME|, may Uman bless you!.
npc.zirella.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, heaven must have sent you! Could you please help me with a {quest}?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_2: [EN] Welcome back, darling... so about that firewood, could you please {help} me?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_3: [EN] Welcome back, darling... so about the {dead trees}, let me explain that a little more, {yes}?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_4: [EN] Welcome back, darling... so about the {branches}, let me explain that a little more, {yes}?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_5: [EN] Welcome back, darling... so about the {pushing}, let me explain that a little more, {yes}?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_6: [EN] Welcome back, darling... so about the {cart}, let me explain that a little more, {yes}?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_7: [EN] Oh, sweetheart, is there a problem with the quest? Should I {explain} it again?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_8: [EN] Right, thank you sweetheart! This will be enough to heat my oven. Oh, and you are probably waiting for your reward, {yes}?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_9: [EN] Oh, welcome back, dear Isleth Eagonst! Are you here for a little chat? Just use the highlighted {keywords} again to choose a {topic}.
npc.zirella.multi_1: [EN] Well, you know that old women like me like to talk a lot. If you see three dots at the end of a sentence, I have still something to say and you should not interrupt, like now ...
npc.zirella.multi_2: [EN] Patience is a virtue, young adventurer! So, the quest was to go into the forest south of here and to find a dead tree. Wait, let me continue! ...
npc.zirella.multi_3: [EN] 'Use' a tree to break a dry branch from it. Afterwards, drag and drop the branch back to my cart and select 'Use with', then left-click on my cart. Thanks again for offering your help!
npc.zirella.multi_4: [EN] Thank you darling! My cart is right beside me. It's a little complicated: I need some firewood, but it's very difficult for my slightly advanced age. ...
npc.zirella.multi_5: [EN] Please go into the the forest southeast of here. You will find fine old rotten brown trees. Please RIGHT-CLICK in the lower right corner of that tree and choose 'USE'. That way, a branch should appear on the map. ...
npc.zirella.multi_6: [EN] Don't put it in your inventory like before, but instead DRAG it over the map by LEFT-CLICKING the loose branch, HOLDING the LEFT MOUSE BUTTON and moving it over the map. ...
npc.zirella.multi_7: [EN] When you are close to my cart, USE the branch WITH the cart: RIGHT-CLICK the branch on the floor and select 'USE WITH', Then LEFT-CLICK on the cart. Don't worry, you will see what I mean on the way. Thanks and {bye} for now!
npc.zirella.say_1: [EN] By the way, 'quest' is a keyword that many NPCs react to, especially those which have tasks for you. So darling, about that {quest}... are you listening?
npc.zirella.say_2: [EN] Thank you so much for your kindness. I'm an old woman and I desperately need firewood for my oven. Could you please help me?
npc.zirella.say_3: [EN] You're such a treasure. In the forest south of here, there are {dead trees} without any leaves. The first thing you have to do is search for one, {okay}?
npc.zirella.say_4: [EN] Splendid, once you've found one, 'Use' it to break a branch from it. Did you understand that so far?
npc.zirella.say_5: [EN] Good... so after you broke a branch, please push it here and select 'use with'. That will turn your mouse cursor into crosshairs. Then left-click on my cart. {Alright}?
npc.zirella.say_6: [EN] To push the branch, drag and drop it on the grass by holding the left mousebutton and moving the cursor to where you want to throw the branch. Just push it near my cart before you 'Use' it, {alright}?
npc.zirella.say_7: [EN] Oh, you deserve it. You really have earned some experience! Also, you may enter my little house now and take what's in that chest beside my bed. Good {bye} for now!
npc.zirella.say_8: [EN] Well then, I hope you find nice and dry branches for me! Good {bye}!
npc.zirella.voice_1: [EN] I wish someone could spare a minute and help me...
npc.zirella.voice_2: [EN] This is too hard for an old woman like me.
npc.zirella.voice_3: [EN] Hello, young adventurer, you look strong enough to help me!
npc.ziyad.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.ziyad.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah, the wind brings in another visitor. Welcome, dear guest. Are you looking for a {passage} with my carpet?
npc.ziyad.stdmod_1: [EN] Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.ziyad.stdmod_10: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Svargrond}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Zao}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Edron} or to {Issavi} if you like. Where do you want to go?

npc.zizzle.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah our human {alliez} have finally arrived! I've already feared zat ze emperor'z forzez had caught you. Your rezilienze and prowezz are imprezzive.
npc.zizzle.multi_1: [EN] Didn't exzpect anyzing lezz from you. Alright, zankz to your effortz to build an effective reziztanze, our comradez zalvaged ziz potion and ze formula you need to utter to breach hiz zubconzciouznezz. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_10: [EN] I recommend not to go alone becauze it will be very dangerouz - but ALL of you will have to uze zeir zeptre replicaz on ze emperor'z remainz to prozeed! ...
npc.zizzle.multi_11: [EN] You will need it. Now go to the north of Sleeping Dragon room, {dont need talk} with he! Good luck.
npc.zizzle.multi_12: [EN] Ze dragon emperor controlz ze whole empire wiz hiz willpower. But even he iz not powerful enough to uze ziz control continuouzly wizout zome form of aid. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_13: [EN] Wiz ze ancient zeptre zat you acquired for uz earlier, I can charge ozer zeptrez wiz azpectz of power of ze Great Znake. If you manage to touch one of ze tranzmitter cryztalz wiz ze zeptre, itz godly power will realign ze cryztal. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_14: [EN] Not only will ze cryztal ztop zending ze orderz of ze emperor into ze mindz of my opprezzed people, it will alzo zend a mezzage of freedom and zelf-rezpect inztead. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_15: [EN] Dizabling ze cryztalz will probably alert ze emperor. It will likely be too late for him to intervene in perzon but a creature of hiz power might have ozer wayz to intervene. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_16: [EN] But zere iz more. To reach ze emperor, you will need accezz to hiz inner realmz. Ze zecret to enter iz guarded by a dragon. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_17: [EN] But ziz iz not ze catch - ze catch iz, zat ze key iz buried in hiz vazt mind. Ze emperor haz bound ze dragon to himzelf, forzing him into an eternal zlumber. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_18: [EN] A zignificant part of ze emperor'z power iz uzed to reztrain ze dragon. Ze only way to free him will be to enter hiz dreamz. Are you prepared for ziz?
npc.zizzle.multi_2: [EN] Drink it and when you are cloze to ze dragon zpeak: Z...z.. well, juzt take ze sheet wiz ze word and read it yourzelf. A lot of rebelz have died to retrieve ziz information, uze it wizely. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_3: [EN] Now go and try to find a way to reach ze emperor and to free ze land from it'z opprezzor. Onze you have found a way, return to me and I will explain what to do wiz ze cryztalz. May ze Great Znake guide you!
npc.zizzle.multi_4: [EN] You freed ze dragon! And you pozzezz ze key to enter ze inner realmz of ze emperor, well done. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_5: [EN] Now you are ready to reach ze inner zanctum of ze emperor. Zalamon'z revelationz showed him zat zere are four cryztalz channelling ze will of ze emperor into ze land. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_6: [EN] Wiz ze relic you gained from Zalamon we were able to create powerful replicaz of ze zeptre. Take ziz wiz you. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_7: [EN] You will have to realign ze cryztalz one after ze ozer. Ztart wiz ze one in ze norz-wezt and work your way clockwize zrough ze room. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_8: [EN] Uzing ze zeptre will forze a part of ze emperor'z willpower out of ze cryztal. You will have to kill zoze manifeztationz. ...
npc.zizzle.multi_9: [EN] Zen uze your zeptre on ze remainz to deztroy ze emperor'z influenze over ze cryztal. ...
npc.zizzle.say_1: [EN] You made it! Az zoon az you are prepared, I will brief you for your nexzt mizzion.
npc.zizzle.say_2: [EN] Now go to the north of Sleeping Dragon room, {dont need talk} with he!
npc.zlak.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah, ze human everyone iz talking about. Your victory over ze champion waz quite imprezzive. ...
npc.zlak.greet_msg_2: [EN] Alzough, for many ziz only provez what a huge zreat you blank-zkinz ztill poze. What do you {want}?
npc.zlak.multi_1: [EN] Your eagernezz for killing and bloodshed iz frightening, but your next mizzion will zuit your tazte. Wiz ze zity in chaoz and defenzez diverted, ze ztage iz zet for our final ztrike. ...
npc.zlak.multi_10: [EN] Ze rumour mill iz quite fazt. Ezpecially when zomeone unuzual az you enterz ze zity. Zoon zey will learn zat you have no reazon to be here and our raze will be buzted. ...
npc.zlak.multi_11: [EN] Zo we have to ztrike fazt and quickly. You will have to eliminate zome high ranking key officialz. I zink killing four of zem should be enough. ...
npc.zlak.multi_12: [EN] Ziz will dizrupt ze order in ze zity zignificantly zinze zo much dependz on bureaucracy and ze chain of command. Only chaoz and dizorganization will enable me to help you with ze next ztep in ze plan.
npc.zlak.multi_2: [EN] A large number of rebelz have arrived undercover in ze zity. Zey will attack ze palaze and zome loyal palaze guardz will let zem in. ...
npc.zlak.multi_3: [EN] Meanwhile, you will take ze old ezcape tunnel zat leadz from ze abandoned bazement in ze norz of ze miniztry to a lift zat endz zomewhere in ze palaze. ...
npc.zlak.multi_4: [EN] When everyzing workz according to ze plan, you will meet Zalamon zomewhere in the underground part of ze palaze.
npc.zlak.multi_5: [EN] Word of your deedz iz already zpreading like a wildfire. Zalamon'z plan to unleash zome murderouz beaztz in ze zity workz almozt too well. You are already becoming zome kind of legend with which motherz frighten zeir unruly hatchlingz. ...
npc.zlak.multi_6: [EN] Your next {mizzion} will be a ztrike into ze heart of ze empire.
npc.zlak.multi_7: [EN] Chaoz and panic are already zpreading. Your barbaric brutality iz frightening effectively. I could acquire a key zat we need to get you into ze palaze itzelf. But zere are ztill too many guardz and elite zquadz even for you to fight. ...
npc.zlak.multi_8: [EN] I need you to enter ze zity and zlay at leazt zix noblez. Ze otherz will feel zreatened and call guardz to zemzelvez, and ze dragon kingz will accuze each ozer to be rezponzible for zlaying zeir pet noblez. ...
npc.zlak.multi_9: [EN] Zat should enable uz to give you at leazt a chanze to attack ze palaze.

npc.znozel.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.znozel.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.zoltan.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome |PLAYERNAME|, student of the arcane arts. I teach the fiercest {spells} available.
npc.zoltan.say_1: [EN] Bah, I know. I received some sort of 'nomination' from our outpost in Port Hope. ...
npc.zoltan.say_10: [EN] Usually it takes a little more than that for an award though. However, I honour Myra's word. ...
npc.zoltan.say_11: [EN] I hereby grant you the right to wear a special sign of honour, acknowledged by the academy of Edron. Since you are a woman, I guess you don't want manly stuff. There you go.
npc.zoltan.say_2: [EN] Usually it takes a little more than that for an award though. However, I honour Myra's word. ...
npc.zoltan.say_3: [EN] I hereby grant you the right to wear a special sign of honour, acknowledged by the academy of Edron. Since you are a woman, I guess you don't want manly stuff. There you go.
npc.zoltan.say_4: [EN] I bow to you, player, and hereby grant you the right to wear Ferumbras' hat as accessory. Congratulations!
npc.zoltan.say_5: [EN] Sorry you don't have the Ferumbras' hat.
npc.zoltan.say_6: [EN] This task is only available for male players who don't already have the addon.
npc.zoltan.say_7: [EN] Stop bothering me. I am a far too busy man to be constantly giving out awards.
npc.zoltan.say_8: [EN] What the hell are you talking about?
npc.zoltan.say_9: [EN] Bah, I know. I received some sort of 'nomination' from our outpost in Port Hope. ...
npc.zora.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.zora.say_1: [EN] Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.zora.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
npc.zora.stdmod_1: [EN] I sell equipment for your adventure! Just ask me for a {trade} to see my wares.
npc.ztiss.multi_1: [EN] Excellent! Now you may leave ziz area zrough ze teleporter to ze norz. It will bring you to a hidden boat. Ziz boat will take you to ze tournament izle. ...
npc.ztiss.multi_2: [EN] Zere you'll learn anyzing you need to know about ze great tournament.
npc.ztiss.multi_3: [EN] You are zmart for a zoftzkin, but before you begin to feel too zmart, you should know zat we will zeal our deal wiz you drinking a ztrong poizon zat will inevitably kill you if you want to trick me and not attend ze tournament. ...
npc.ztiss.multi_4: [EN] Zo are you ready to drink ziz poizon here?
npc.ztiss.multi_5: [EN] Zere iz a great tournament of ztrengz each decade. It determinez ze granted privilegez for zertain individualz of power for ze comming decade. ...
npc.ztiss.multi_6: [EN] My mazter wantz to zurprize hiz opponentz by an unexpected move. He will uze warriorz from ze outzide, zomeone zat no one can azzezz. ...
npc.ztiss.multi_7: [EN] One of ziz warriorz could be you. Or you could ztay here and rot in ze dungeon. Are you interezted in ziz deal?
npc.ztiss.multi_8: [EN] Ziz iz not for you to azk. I work for zomeone of immenze power. He haz an {offer} for you.
npc.ztiss.say_1: [EN] You are ztill a captive and your life is forfeit. Zere might be a way for you to ezcape if you agree to {work} for my mazter.
npc.zumtah.greet_msg_1: [EN] Another visitor to this constricted, cosy, calm realm, perfect except for an {exit}. Muhaha.
npc.zumtah.multi_1: [EN] Oh, excuse me of course, you... wanted to go. Like all... the others. I am sorry, so sorry. You... you can leave. Yes. You can go. You are free. I shall stay here and help every poor soul which ever gets thrown in here from this day onward. ...
npc.zumtah.multi_2: [EN] Yes, I will redeem myself. Maybe in another 278 years. ...
npc.zumtah.multi_3: [EN] If you want to go, just ask for an {exit} and I will transform you into a creature small enough to fit through that hole over there.
npc.zumtah.say_1: [EN] You are searching for the way out? Do you want to go home? Are you homesick, nostalgic, allergic? I am sorry. You will stay. Muhahahaha. Haha. Are you giving up then?
npc.zumtah.say_10: [EN] You are starting to get on my nerves. Is this the only topic you know?
npc.zumtah.say_11: [EN] But there is no escape, I said NO. You've already asked several times and my answer will stay the same. What is this? Are you trying to test me?
npc.zumtah.say_12: [EN] Muhahaha. Where? I can only see a dark cave with nothing than bones and a djinn in it. You mean that small hole there? Muhahaha.
npc.zumtah.say_14: [EN] Muhahaha. Then I will give you a test. How many years do you think have I been here? {89}, {164} or {278}?
npc.zumtah.say_15: [EN] Correct human, and that is not nearly how high you would need to count to tell all the lost souls I've seen dying here. I AM PERPETUAL. Muahahaha.
npc.zumtah.say_2: [EN] A what? I don't even know what you're talking about, human. If you aren't just giving up - will you kindly change the topic please?
npc.zumtah.say_3: [EN] Haha, no! No. Why don't you just stop asking me that and start enjoying your stay here?
npc.zumtah.say_4: [EN] Oh, you mean - if I have ever been out of here in those 278 years? Well, I - I can't remember. No, I can't remember. Sorry.
npc.zumtah.say_5: [EN] No, I really can't remember. I enjoyed my stay here so much that I forgot how it looks outside of this hole. Outside. The air, the sky, the light. Oh well... well.
npc.zumtah.say_6: [EN] Oh yes, yes. I... I never really thought about how you creatures feel in here I guess. I... just watched all these beings die here. ...
npc.zumtah.say_7: [EN] Alright, as I said you are free now. There will not be an outside for the next three centuries, but you - go. ...
npc.zumtah.say_8: [EN] It's you, why did they throw you in here again? Anyway, I will just transform you once more. I also recovered your crate which will wait for you at the exit. There, feel free to go.
npc.zumtah.say_9: [EN] I've already told you that you can't get out. What's the problem? Do you even see an exit?
npc.zumtah.stdmod_1: [EN] I wait. I wait for someone like you to come here. I wait for them to grow disconsolate. I wait for them to despair. And I wait for them to die. Muhahaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_2: [EN] I am Zumtah, Zumtah the impeccable, Zumtah the marvellous, Zumtah the... the... eternal.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_3: [EN] The land you are currently dwelling in, human. Don't you have any sense of your surroundings?
npc.zumtah.stdmod_4: [EN] I have seen many of them. I have seen many of them die. In here, with me. Perhaps you will be pleased to meet them. Not long and you will join their ranks. Muhaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_5: [EN] Pesky creatures. Many of them have been brought here, many of them died here. Humans, lizards, beasts, they all die the same. Down here, with me. Muhahaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_6: [EN] What? What do you mean by that?
npc.zumtah.stdmod_7: [EN] Hmm, an old one. I don't care much about politics or power, as here, he has none. Here, only I have power. Muhaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_8: [EN] What are you talking about, such things do not matter down here. Down here alone, isolated and broken. Muhaha.
npc.zurak.say_1: [EN] You want trip to Izzle of Zztrife?
npc.zurak.say_2: [EN] You need permission to travel to.
npc.zurak.say_3: [EN] It'zz your doom you travel to.
npc.zurak.say_5: [EN] Me zzimple ferryman. I arrange {trip} to Izzle of Zztrife.
npc.zurak_arena.say_1: [EN] You want trip to Izzle of Zzao?
npc.zurak_arena.say_2: [EN] You need permission to travel to.
npc.zurak_arena.say_5: [EN] Me zzimple ferryman. I arrange {trip} to Zzao.
